title: Back End - Java Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 59654


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera desenvolvedor(a), chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em Java e seu ecossistema.
  • Conhecimento em Terraform para infraestrutura como código (IaC).
  • Vivência com práticas e ferramentas de CI/CD.
  • Domínio de versionamento com Git.
  • Experiência com GitHub e GitLab (repositórios, pipelines e gestão de código).
  • Experiência em AWS (ECS (containers e orquestração), RDS (bancos relacionais gerenciados), DynamoDB (banco NoSQL), S3 (armazenamento de objetos), SQS (filas), SNS (tópicos e notificações), Lambda (computação serverless) e API Gateway (gerenciamento e exposição de APIs)).



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Modelo Híbrido; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Technical Support Specialist - Remote Position (Brazil)
description:
Are you a problem-solving enthusiast with a passion for technology and complex problem

resolution? Magentrix, a leading provider of Partner Relationship Management (PRM) and Customer

Portal solutions, is seeking a Technical Support Specialist to join our growing team!


About Magentrix: What we’re all about: Collaboration. We aim to improve collaboration. In

today’s world, the need for collaboration has become ever more important and the need for tools to

help make it easier only continues to grow.


Position Overview: We're looking for an exceptional Technical Support Specialist who can think

outside the box and deliver outstanding customer support. This role combines solution engineering

expertise with creative problem-solving to ensure our customers get the most out of their Magentrix

experience.


What You'll Do:


Provide expert-level technical support for Magentrix software, troubleshooting issues and

isolating root causes

Think quickly and critically to diagnose, investigate, and resolve complex technical

problems eƯiciently

Guide customers in navigating the platform and its various modules to ensure optimal use

and eƯiciency

Apply solution engineering principles to design and recommend tailored configurations,

integrations, and optimizations that meet customer needs

Go above and beyond to deliver the 'Magentrix Magic Experience' by providing outstanding

customer service at every interaction

Work closely with internal teams to escalate and resolve complex technical issues, sharing

innovative ideas to enhance support processes

Maintain and update Knowledge Base articles to improve self-service resources for clients

Provide regular status updates to management, clients, and all relevant stakeholders

Analyze customer needs and platform usage to provide strategic recommendations for

improved performance, functionality, and eƯiciency


Required Qualifications


5+ years of experience in Customer Support/Technical Support roles

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent

Fluent in English (spoken and written)

Strong problem-solving skills with deep investigative and analytical abilities

Excellent technical writing skills with experience creating clear, concise documentation and

knowledge base articles

Ability to work independently and think outside the box to solve technical challenges

Ability to work Eastern Time Zone hours (8 AM to 8 PM ET)

Current residence in Brazil

Experience in customer-facing roles with demonstrated communication excellence


Bonus Skills:


Technical knowledge of CSS, JavaScript, JSON, C#, .NET, and HTML

Previous experience with CRM systems (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, or HubSpot)

Salesforce Administration

Experience with SAML-based SSO and identity management solutions

Customer Success experience


What Sets You Apart:


You're a fast thinker who thrives in dynamic environments

You have a knack for thinking outside the box

You're naturally curious and enjoy deep investigation

You can work independently while maintaining strong team collaboration


Why Join Us:


Join a growing, innovative company

Develop your skills with a supportive team

Career advancement opportunities and professional growth paths

Make a real impact on customer success

Remote work flexibility


Ready to take your career to the next level? Apply now and join our dynamic team at Magentrix!

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento de Software II
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Analisar e compreender requisitos de negócio em conjunto com product managers e analistas, traduzindo necessidades em especificações técnicas
  • Projetar arquiteturas de software e definir soluções técnicas para features de crédito, considerando escalabilidade, segurança e performance
  • Desenvolver código de produção seguindo padrões de qualidade, boas práticas de programação e convenções estabelecidas pelo time
  • Escrever e manter testes unitários, de integração e end-to-end para garantir qualidade e confiabilidade do código
  • Realizar code reviews de forma construtiva, garantindo qualidade técnica e alinhamento com padrões do time
  • Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis (daily, planning, retrospectiva) contribuindo com insights técnicos e de negócio
  • Colaborar com designers e product managers na definição de soluções que equilibrem viabilidade técnica e necessidades do usuário
  • Investigar e resolver problemas em produção, analisando logs, métricas e comportamento do sistema para identificar causas raiz
  • Monitorar métricas de performance, disponibilidade e saúde dos sistemas de crédito em produção
  • Documentar decisões técnicas, arquiteturas e processos de desenvolvimento para facilitar manutenção e onboarding
  • Refatorar código legado quando necessário, melhorando qualidade, legibilidade e manutenibilidade sem alterar comportamento
  • Participar de discussões sobre evolução de produtos de crédito, propondo melhorias técnicas e de negócio baseadas em dados
  • Garantir segurança e conformidade nas soluções desenvolvidas, seguindo práticas de segurança da informação e regulamentações do setor financeiro
  • Colaborar na definição e evolução de padrões técnicos, ferramentas e processos de desenvolvimento do time
  • Investigar e corrigir bugs reportados pela operação ou identificados através de monitoramento, priorizando impacto no negócio



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Node.js (runtime, event loop, módulos nativos, performance)
  • TypeScript (tipos avançados, generics, decorators, utility types)
  • JavaScript ES6+ (async/await, promises, destructuring, spread operator)
  • SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) - queries complexas, otimização, índices, transações
  • NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis) - modelagem de dados, agregações, cache strategies
  • ORMs e Query Builders (TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize, Knex)
  • Migrations e versionamento de schema
  • Docker (Dockerfile, docker-compose)
  • Conceitos de containers, volumes, networks
  • Boas práticas de containerização para aplicações Node.js ;
  • Git (branching strategies, merge/rebase, hooks)
  • CI/CD (Bitbucket CI, GitLab CI) - pipelines, testes automatizados, deploy
  • Clean Code e SOLID principles
  • Design Patterns (Factory, Strategy, Repository, Dependency Injection)
  • Arquitetura de software (RESTful APIs, microserviços, event-driven)
  • Testes (unitários, integração, E2E) - Jest, Mocha, Chai, Supertest
  • Code review e pair programming
  • Gerenciadores de pacotes (npm, yarn, pnpm)
  • Debugging (Node.js ;debugger, Chrome DevTools)
  • Monitoramento e logging (Winston, Pino, Sentry)
  • Metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban)
  • Documentação técnica (API docs, arquitetura, ADRs)
  • Versionamento semântico (SemVer)



Informações adicionais


• Vale alimentação ou Refeição para fazer as compras para sua casa ou comer no seu restaurante preferido;

• Plano de saúde e odontológico para você e sua família;

• Previdência privada para sua reserva financeira e investimentos;

• Seguro de Vida, para dar mais tranquilidade a você e a quem você ama;

• Participação nos lucros, como incentivo pelo seu trabalho e resultados;

• Programas de qualidade de vida que garantem o bem-estar e promovem a saúde dos nossos colaboradores;

• Wellhub que te dá acesso a mais de 18 mil academias no Brasil.



Se você possui os pré requisitos da vaga, faça sua candidatura e fique atento nas dicas:


- Durante a jornada do processo de seleção, a comunicação será via e-mail ou por telefone.

- Certifique que seus dados estão atualizados e fique de olho na sua caixa. de e-mail, sem esquecer da caixa de spam.

- Fique atento nas ligações, os nossos telefones corporativos possuem variação de DDD.



Caso receba um feedback negativo, não desanime, fique atento a outras oportunidades.

title: Data Engineer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


Please note that we're aiming at an expatriation to Portugal


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of “large company” in 2018. We now have more than 350 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria , as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. Working with Affinity is a “Lifetime Experience ” where you will have the opportunity to demonstrate all your potential and to be successful on every level.


#welcometoyourfuture


What you need to have

  • College degree in IT Engineering, Computer Science, or similar;
  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering or related roles;
  • Strong experience with data pipeline design and development (batch and streaming);
  • Proficiency in Python and/or Scala for data processing;
  • Experience with SQL and relational/non-relational data modeling;
  • Experience with big data frameworks (Apache Spark, Kafka, Airflow, or similar);
  • Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms (Azure Data Factory, Databricks, AWS Glue, Redshift, or similar);
  • Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and lakehouse architectures;
  • Familiarity with data governance and data quality practices;
  • Excellent English skills (C1/C2);
  • Availability to relocate to Portugal.


Nice to have

  • Experience with dbt, Delta Lake, or Apache Iceberg;
  • Familiarity with real-time/streaming architectures (Kafka, Flink);
  • Knowledge of BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar);


What we expect from you

  • Will to exceed expectations (your own and the ones defined by Affinity);
  • Exceptional skills and the will to acquire more;
  • Good people skills (not just in terms of technology, language, and platforms), team spirit, and pleasant disposition;
  • Autonomy, proactivity, and focus (even under pressure);
  • Obsession for doing things right, and ability to prioritize;
  • Versatility (you can be a fan of BYOD or not);
  • Ability to innovate and evolve in a market in constant mutation.


What will encourage you

  • Being part of a company that has a disruptive action in the technology market;
  • Being part of a technology focused on relationships, simplicity, and efficiency;
  • Accessing a generative career directly proportional to your performance and interest;
  • The real possibility of being part of our company staff.


Do you think you're the one we are looking for?

Let’s chat ! Send your application and take a look at :

title: Scrum Master - Júnior
description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.


Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:


Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Engajamento: Na Bluesoft, atuamos com energia, buscamos a excelência e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva para crescer juntos e alcançar grandes resultados.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Sobre a vaga:


Na Bluesoft , o Analista de Processos (Scrum Master) tem o papel de impulsionar a eficiência e a colaboração entre times, garantindo que nossas entregas aconteçam com clareza, consistência e alinhamento às necessidades dos clientes. Buscamos alguém que seja facilitador, analítico, comunicativo e apaixonado por criar ambientes de trabalho saudáveis e colaborativos


Principais atividades:

  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (Daily, Planning, Retrospectiva, Review e Refinamento).
  • Monitorar riscos, identificar gargalos e apoiar o time na tomada de decisão para manter o fluxo de entrega.
  • Acompanhar prazos e demandas junto aos times e áreas envolvidas, apoiando a gestão de projetos quando necessário.
  • Dar visibilidade às métricas e indicadores de performance (ex.: Lead Time, Throughput, Bugs, Previsibilidade).
  • Atuar de forma proativa em situações críticas, ajudando na análise de alternativas e planos de ação sustentáveis.
  • Garantir que as retrospectivas resultem em ações práticas, com responsáveis e acompanhamento contínuo.
  • Manter e atualizar a documentação de processos, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Facilitar o alinhamento entre áreas (Produto, Desenvolvimento, QA, Implantação e Processos).
  • Apoiar onboarding de novos integrantes do time e organizar feedbacks para fortalecer a comunicação e aprendizagem.
  • Prover diagnóstico de causa-raiz e múltiplas opções estratégicas para a solução de impedimentos críticos, garantindo que a decisão final seja informada e eficaz.
  • Atuar como um agente de challenge e facilitador de melhorias, questionando processos ineficientes, estimativas não realistas ou decisões que possam comprometer a previsibilidade e a qualidade da entrega
  • Disseminar a cultura ágil, promovendo autonomia, colaboração e evolução contínua.


Requisitos Indispensáveis:

  • Experiência prática com Scrum , Kanban e fundamentos de Lean .
  • Habilidade em comunicação, empatia e facilitação de grupos.
  • Visão sistêmica e capacidade de analisar processos ponta a ponta.
  • Organização e disciplina para acompanhamento de tarefas, ações e métricas.
  • Postura proativa e orientada a soluções, atuando como agente de mudança.
  • Desejo de construir um ambiente colaborativo, transparente e que estimule aprendizados constantes.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão (ex.: Jira, Azure DevOps, Miro).
  • Experiência com times de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Certificações ágeis (CSM, PSM, KSD, KSI ou similares).

We now have more than 350 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria , as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. #welcometoyourfuture

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Senior Oracle Project Manager – Oracle ERP & Legacy Ecosystems


We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead complex, high-impact initiatives across Oracle ecosystems and legacy systems . This PM is focused on managing strategic improvement programs, regulatory adaptations (including Brazilian Tax Reform), system updates, enhancements, testing cycles, and the delivery of new functionalities in enterprise environments.


The ideal candidate demonstrates a proactive, dynamic, and ownership-driven mindset , with strong systemic and strategic vision, the ability to anticipate risks, and proven experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder projects.


Required Experience & Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Senior Project Manager in complex enterprise IT environments.
  • Strong background managing projects within Oracle ecosystems (Oracle EBS ERP and related solutions) and legacy systems .
  • Solid experience leading large-scale improvements, regulatory compliance initiatives, system upgrades, and testing programs .
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex stakeholder landscapes and executive-level communication.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end systems integration and dependency management .
  • Experience in environments with high regulatory and operational complexity .
  • Excellent leadership, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end project management for complex initiatives involving Oracle platforms and legacy systems .
  • Manage projects related to system improvements, regulatory adaptations (e.g., Tax Reform), upgrades, updates, testing cycles, and new functionality rollouts .
  • Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, IT teams, vendors, and executive leadership .
  • Drive governance, planning, execution, monitoring, and control of multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Anticipate risks, issues, and dependencies, proactively proposing mitigation strategies and corrective actions.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives, regulatory requirements, and technology solutions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional and multicultural teams, including internal teams, subcontractors, and partners.
  • Oversee scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk management.
  • Deliver clear, concise project communication, status reports, executive presentations, and decision papers.
  • Support strategic planning, roadmap definition, and prioritization of initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate governance, security, quality, and audit requirements.


Desired Profile

  • Proactive and dynamic professional with a strong sense of ownership .
  • Strategic mindset with strong systemic vision .
  • Ability to anticipate issues and risks before they materialize .
  • Results-driven, resilient, and adaptable to changing priorities.
  • Strong decision-making capability and accountability.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous and high-pressure environments.


Contract & Work Model

  • PJ (contractor) model
  • Long-term engagement: 1 year, renewable
  • Primarily remote, with sporadic national travel as needed

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora | Java Pleno
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO :

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções técnicas de média e alta complexidade, com boa autonomia, utilizando as tecnologias, frameworks e padrões adotados nos projetos da área.
  • Analisar, compreender e evoluir a arquitetura das aplicações, avaliando componentes, integrações, estrutura, segurança e regras de negócio envolvidas.
  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir funcionalidades com foco em qualidade, desempenho, segurança, escalabilidade e aderência às necessidades do negócio.
  • Criar, manter e apoiar a evolução de testes manuais e automatizados, contribuindo para a confiabilidade das entregas e para a cobertura dos requisitos funcionais e técnicos.
  • Participar ativamente da definição técnica das soluções, contribuindo com análises, sugestões de melhoria e apoio ao time na tomada de decisão.
  • Documentar implementações, fluxos, decisões técnicas e etapas do desenvolvimento, utilizando ferramentas de versionamento, rastreabilidade e documentação técnica.
  • Realizar detalhamento técnico de demandas em conjunto com clientes, analistas de negócio e demais áreas envolvidas, transformando requisitos funcionais em soluções viáveis, sustentáveis e aderentes à arquitetura definida.
  • Garantir a qualidade do software por meio da aplicação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento, revisão de código, padronização e uso adequado de frameworks, servidores de aplicação e ferramentas corporativas.
  • Atuar em conjunto com desenvolvedores, analistas, QA e áreas parceiras, promovendo alinhamento técnico e funcional ao longo do ciclo de desenvolvimento.
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas e funcionais com time e cliente, apoiando o esclarecimento de dúvidas, o refinamento de escopo e a evolução contínua das soluções.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Experiência com Java JDK 8 ou 17
  • Vivência com Spring Boot, JAX-WS, JAX-RS, CDI, JPA, JEE, JSF, EJB e AngularJS
  • Experiência com WildFly 11 e/ou 18
  • Conhecimento em construção e consumo de APIs REST e SOAP
  • Experiência com Keycloak, utilizando OAuth2 / OpenID Connect (Bearer Token)
  • Conhecimento sólido em JPA / Hibernate
  • Experiência com banco de dados Oracle
  • Vivência com Git
  • Aplicação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento e princípios de design como SOLID
  • Vivência com Maven para build e gerenciamento de dependências
  • Experiência em análise, desenvolvimento, manutenção e sustentação de sistemas corporativos
  • Capacidade de atuar com autonomia na análise e solução de problemas técnicos
  • Boa comunicação para interação com time técnico, áreas de negócio e clientes


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER :

  • Vivência em sustentação, suporte e atendimento a clientes em ambientes corporativos
  • Experiência com SQL Server ou ORACLE
  • Conhecimento em Kafka para mensageria e integração entre sistemas
  • Atuação em times que utilizam Métodos Ágeis
  • Vivência no uso de Inteligência Artificial aplicada ao desenvolvimento de software, com foco em produtividade, apoio à análise técnica, documentação, testes e troubleshooting

Assistência Médica

title: Delivery Manager (Internacional)
description:
A Avenue Code é uma consultoria global de tecnologia especializada em transformação digital, desenvolvimento de software e soluções de alta performance para grandes empresas ao redor do mundo. Fazemos parte da AI/R Company , um ecossistema global de inovação que conecta tecnologia, dados e inteligência artificial para impulsionar negócios.


Sobre a posição:

Você irá atuar como Delivery Manager em um cliente internacional, sendo facilitador entre times técnicos e stakeholders. Essa pessoa é responsável por garantir a excelência na entrega, remover impedimentos, apoiar decisões estratégicas e assegurar que a cultura, os objetivos e a estratégia do cliente sejam bem compreendidos e disseminados dentro do time. Além disso, o papel tem forte atuação em gestão de pessoas, acompanhamento de performance e relacionamento com o cliente, contribuindo para a saúde da conta e identificação de oportunidades de negócio.


Responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar e garantir a performance dos times alocados no cliente
  • Atuar como ponto focal do cliente para temas relacionados à entrega
  • Conduzir reuniões recorrentes com clientes (status, performance, riscos e alinhamentos)
  • Elaborar e acompanhar relatórios de performance, KPIs, riscos e indicadores da conta
  • Conduzir processos de onboarding do time (Avenue Code e cliente)
  • Realizar entrevistas com foco em culture fit
  • Conduzir avaliações de desempenho, feedbacks contínuos e reuniões 1:1
  • Criar e acompanhar planos de desenvolvimento individuais (PDI)
  • Apoiar ações de retenção, promoções, negociações e movimentações internas
  • Controlar horas trabalhadas e apoiar a gestão de capacidade do time
  • Atuar em reuniões de attrition e análise de riscos de turnover
  • Apoiar e manter a documentação interna relacionada ao cliente
  • Apoiar a liderança da Avenue Code na tomada de decisões estratégicas



Requisitos

  • Inglês avançado ou fluente (excelente comunicação verbal e escrita)
  • Experiência em gestão de pessoas
  • Experiência em consultoria de tecnologia e com contato direto com clientes

title: Associate Account Executive - Biopharma
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as AbbVie, Astrazeneca, Pfizer, Merck. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


Our Biopharma team is growing, and we are looking for an experienced Associate Account Executive to expand institutional sales of our scientific video journal and databases to biopharma companies in North America. If you are ambitious, results-driven, and can develop relationships with scientists and progress opportunities, this position could be an excellent opportunity for you.


Responsibilities:


  • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing business for assigned biopharma accounts.
  • Conduct active outreach to build and progress opportunities in the pipeline to meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Build and execute a persistent outbound sales strategy, including cold calls and emails, to generate interest and accelerate new business generation.
  • Establish and maintain strong and professional relationships with biopharma librarians, R&D leadership and stakeholders.
  • Work with the marketing and customer success teams to customize marketing activities & provide support for each account.


Requirements:


  • A bachelor's degree
  • 2+ years of direct selling experience to stakeholders in the pharmaceutical, biotech, device, or healthcare industry.
  • Demonstrated success in meeting and exceeding sales objectives.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-makers and manage a full sales cycle.
  • Highly effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • A disciplined approach to daily activity planning, setting goals, and achieving success.
  • Experience with Salesforce or relevant sales CRM, MS Office is required.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package, including unlimited commissions.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and productivity.
  • Opportunity to work in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Client Success Manager

  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) process and related technical roles

We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Vmware Consultant
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced VMware NSX Consultant to join our team on a contract basis. In this role, you will serve as a subject matter expert driving the architecture, deployment, and optimization of VMware NSX environments. You'll play a critical role in shaping network virtualization strategies, leading technical engagements, and delivering scalable, secure solutions across private and hybrid cloud infrastructures.

Responsibilities


Architecture & Deployment

  • Lead end-to-end architecture, design, and deployment of VMware NSX and Aria Operations for Networks
  • Design and implement multi-site architectures including network provisioning, workload management, configuration management, and disaster recovery strategies
  • Integrate NSX with third-party platforms spanning infrastructure, storage, networking, and security solutions


Operations & Management

  • Oversee deployment, configuration, and ongoing management of NSX and Aria Operations for Networks
  • Develop and enforce micro-segmentation policies to strengthen network security posture
  • Ensure adherence to industry standards, security policies, and compliance requirements


Collaboration & Leadership

  • Lead technical discussions, workshops, and knowledge transfer sessions for internal teams
  • Mentor junior consultants and provide guidance on troubleshooting and optimization
  • Participate in pre-sales engagements to scope and position NSX-based networking solutions
  • Develop and deliver technical documentation, design documents, and deployment best practices


Experience

  • 15+ years of hands-on technical experience with VMware and supporting technologies
  • 5+ years as a network engineer or architect
  • Proven experience deploying, upgrading, and managing NSX-T environments
  • Experience migrating NSX-V to NSX-T environments
  • Hands-on experience with Aria Operations for Networks (vRNI) for traffic analysis and micro-segmentation
  • Experience installing, configuring, and managing virtual networks and virtual load balancers
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment


Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to lead cross-functional technical discussions


Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field


Certifications

  • Required: VCP-NV
  • Preferred: VCP-DCV, VCP-CMA, VCAP-DCV, VCAP-CMA, VCDX-NV, VCP-VCF, VCAP-NV

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Analista de dados sênior
description:
Requisitos Obrigatórios


Desenvolver e executar análises de dados de ponta a ponta para múltiplas áreas da empresa, incluindo operações, pagamentos e marketing, utilizando principalmente SQL , Google Sheets e Looker Platform . Criar, corrigir e otimizar tabelas, pipelines e regras de negócio, assegurando integridade, performance e escalabilidade. Usar métodos estatísticos e algoritmos de machine learning para criar modelos preditivos. Validar dados e indicadores críticos, investigando inconsistências e propondo melhorias. Experiência avançada em SQL e BigQuery ou SQL Server , além de experiência avançada em R . Habilidade para traduzir análises complexas em informações compreensíveis e proatividade para acompanhar indicadores.


Requisitos Desejáveis


Experiência em análises que envolvem múltiplas áreas de negócio. Vivência em GitHub , Looker ou outras ferramentas de data visualization . Capacidade de resolver problemas com foco em resultados para o negócio. Experiência em digital analytics com ferramentas como Google Analytics , Google Tag Manager e Appsflyer . Conhecimento em técnicas avançadas de ETL e transformação de dados .


Resumo dos requisitos: SQL , Google Sheets , Looker Platform , Machine Learning , GitHub , R , BigQuery , SQL Server , Google Analytics , Google Tag Manager , Appsflyer .

title: AI Trainer
description:
We are looking for motivated individuals residing in Brazil to join our team as Freelance AI Trainers . This is an entry-level opportunity perfect for undergraduate students and freshers who are native Portuguese speakers and eager to contribute to the development of next-generation artificial intelligence.


Role Overview

As an AI Trainer, you will help improve the accuracy and quality of AI models by reviewing, labeling, and generating text-based content. Your insights as a native speaker are essential to ensuring the AI understands the nuances of the Portuguese language and Brazilian culture.


Key Responsibilities

  • Data Labeling: Categorize and annotate text data to help the AI understand context and intent.
  • Content Evaluation: Review AI-generated responses for accuracy, tone, and grammatical correctness.
  • Writing & Rewriting: Create high-quality sample dialogues or prompts in native Portuguese.
  • Fact-Checking: Verify information to ensure the AI provides reliable and safe responses.


Requirements

  • Language: Native-level proficiency in Portuguese (written and verbal).
  • Location: Must be a current resident of Brazil .
  • Education: Currently enrolled in an undergraduate program or a recent graduate (Freshers are encouraged to apply!).
  • Skills: Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and the ability to follow complex guidelines.
  • Tech Savvy: Comfortable working with online platforms and basic productivity tools.
  • Equipment: Access to a reliable computer and high-speed internet.


Compensation & Benefits


  • Rate: $4 USD per hour .
  • Flexibility: Work from anywhere in Brazil with a schedule that fits your studies or other commitments.
  • Experience: Gain hands-on experience in the rapidly growing field of Artificial Intelligence.

title: Associate Account Executive - Biopharma
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as AbbVie, Astrazeneca, Pfizer, Merck. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


Our Biopharma team is growing, and we are looking for an experienced Associate Account Executive to expand institutional sales of our scientific video journal and databases to biopharma companies in North America. If you are ambitious, results-driven, and can develop relationships with scientists and progress opportunities, this position could be an excellent opportunity for you.


Responsibilities:


  • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing business for assigned biopharma accounts.
  • Conduct active outreach to build and progress opportunities in the pipeline to meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Build and execute a persistent outbound sales strategy, including cold calls and emails, to generate interest and accelerate new business generation.
  • Establish and maintain strong and professional relationships with biopharma librarians, R&D leadership and stakeholders.
  • Work with the marketing and customer success teams to customize marketing activities & provide support for each account.


Requirements:


  • A bachelor's degree
  • 2+ years of direct selling experience to stakeholders in the pharmaceutical, biotech, device, or healthcare industry.
  • Demonstrated success in meeting and exceeding sales objectives.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-makers and manage a full sales cycle.
  • Highly effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • A disciplined approach to daily activity planning, setting goals, and achieving success.
  • Experience with Salesforce or relevant sales CRM, MS Office is required.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package, including unlimited commissions.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and productivity.
  • Opportunity to work in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Analista de dados sênior
description:
Sobre a DataEX:

Com 12 anos de atuação no mercado, a DataEX é uma consultoria especializada em Dados e IA , com parcerias estratégicas com Microsoft, AWS e Databricks , atuando em projetos de alto impacto para grandes clientes. Valorizamos a inovação, a colaboração, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a qualidade de vida , com incentivos para certificações e bem-estar.


Contexto do projeto:

A DataEX busca empresa/profissional autônomo para prestação de serviços técnicos especializados em projeto na área de Dados, com atuação junto a cliente de grande porte, no contexto de iniciativas de Análise de Dados. A eventual relação jurídica será formalizada mediante contrato civil de prestação de serviços, com autonomia técnica e operacional.


Perfil técnico esperado:

  • Vasta experiência em análise de dados e resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Experiência em mentoria e desenvolvimento de times.
  • Profundo conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização e análise de dados (Power BI).
  • Experiência na definição e implementação de estratégias analíticas.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem dimensional.
  • Experiência em levantamento e entendimento de requisitos de negócio.
  • Vivência com consumo e manipulação de dados em ambientes de Big Data .

  • Experiência com Data Lakes / Lakehouses (ex: Amazon S3, Athena, Glue, Azure Data Lake, Databricks ou similares).
  • Experiência em ambientes de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou similares), de acordo com o contexto do projeto.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, com capacidade de traduzir dados em insights e influenciar decisões estratégicas.


Escopo de atuação:

  • Realizar e validar requisitos de negócio.
  • Realizar e validar a modelagem dimensional (conceitual, lógica e fisica).
  • Executar projetos analíticos, desde a concepção até a entrega.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Senior Oracle Project Manager – Oracle ERP & Legacy Ecosystems


We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead complex, high-impact initiatives across Oracle ecosystems and legacy systems . This PM is focused on managing strategic improvement programs, regulatory adaptations (including Brazilian Tax Reform), system updates, enhancements, testing cycles, and the delivery of new functionalities in enterprise environments.


The ideal candidate demonstrates a proactive, dynamic, and ownership-driven mindset , with strong systemic and strategic vision, the ability to anticipate risks, and proven experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder projects.


Required Experience & Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Senior Project Manager in complex enterprise IT environments.
  • Strong background managing projects within Oracle ecosystems (Oracle EBS ERP and related solutions) and legacy systems .
  • Solid experience leading large-scale improvements, regulatory compliance initiatives, system upgrades, and testing programs .
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex stakeholder landscapes and executive-level communication.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end systems integration and dependency management .
  • Experience in environments with high regulatory and operational complexity .
  • Excellent leadership, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end project management for complex initiatives involving Oracle platforms and legacy systems .
  • Manage projects related to system improvements, regulatory adaptations (e.g., Tax Reform), upgrades, updates, testing cycles, and new functionality rollouts .
  • Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, IT teams, vendors, and executive leadership .
  • Drive governance, planning, execution, monitoring, and control of multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Anticipate risks, issues, and dependencies, proactively proposing mitigation strategies and corrective actions.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives, regulatory requirements, and technology solutions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional and multicultural teams, including internal teams, subcontractors, and partners.
  • Oversee scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk management.
  • Deliver clear, concise project communication, status reports, executive presentations, and decision papers.
  • Support strategic planning, roadmap definition, and prioritization of initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate governance, security, quality, and audit requirements.


Desired Profile

  • Proactive and dynamic professional with a strong sense of ownership .
  • Strategic mindset with strong systemic vision .
  • Ability to anticipate issues and risks before they materialize .
  • Results-driven, resilient, and adaptable to changing priorities.
  • Strong decision-making capability and accountability.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous and high-pressure environments.


Contract & Work Model

  • PJ (contractor) model
  • Long-term engagement: 1 year, renewable
  • Primarily remote, with sporadic national travel as needed

title: Client Success Manager
description:
Client Success Manager

We are looking for a full-time, remote Client Success Manager with 4+ years of experience working in a software, technical recruiting, or technical outsourcing client services role. This role combines client advocacy with revenue responsibilities, focusing on retention and growth within existing client accounts.

This individual will build loyalty and long-term engagement with our clients driving strategy and execution within client retention programs, account reviews, health checks, cross-sales, issue resolution, interview management, KPI tracking and administration, and more.

Reporting to the Head of Client Success, you will advocate for the client across all of Velozient and will play an integral role in our service delivery team.


Responsibilities

  • Develop strong client relationships built on high responsiveness and advocacy
  • Serve as the primary owner of account growth plans, including retention, expansion, and long-term account value
  • Identify and close new sales opportunities within existing accounts, build job descriptions when necessary, and kick off new job recruiting efforts
  • Plan and execute successful client retention programs that drive loyalty and satisfaction measured by NPS and CSAT respectively
  • Review and submit candidates for open client jobs
  • Coordinate candidate interviews and gather feedback communicating next steps within the People Success (a.k.a., recruiting) and Account Management teams
  • Collaborate with account managers on key account activity
  • Conduct client onboarding sessions
  • Perform periodic health checks and ensure new resources are onboarded successfully with the client
  • Collaborate with People Success in investigating and resolving resource issues
  • Provide needed service information to clients including resource holiday calendars and answer general client inquiries
  • Coordinate and contribute to annual account review preparation and execution
  • Exhibit high integrity, a self-starter approach, and commitment to owning work outcomes


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills with the ability to lead executive-level conversations
  • 4+ years of experience in Client Success, Account Management, Client Services, or a related customer-facing role within recruiting, staffing, SaaS, or professional services environments focused on software/technology
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) process and related technical roles
  • Proven ability to build and maintain long-term, trusted client relationships across multiple stakeholder levels, including senior leadership
  • Proven experience growing revenue within existing client accounts through cross selling or account expansion
  • Strong background conducting client onboarding, health checks, and business reviews to ensure successful outcomes and long-term engagement
  • Experience collaborating closely with Sales, Recruiting/Delivery, Operations, and Finance teams to drive client success and account growth
  • Data-driven approach to managing accounts, including tracking KPIs, NPS, CSAT, retention, hiring velocity, and revenue growth
  • Comfort managing complex client environments, navigating change, resolving issues, and balancing client advocacy with business objectives
  • Strong, innate desire to advocate for the client
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, attention to detail, and multi-tasking background
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, accountable, and trustworthy


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, computer science, or a related field
  • Experience selling IT, software development, or outsourcing services
  • Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software engineering company providing outsourced software resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer engineering talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building and delivering software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Staff Data Scientist
description:
Cientista de Dados


Sobre a Arvo

Temos o propósito de tornar a saúde no Brasil mais acessível para todos. Nossa jornada começa com o uso de dados e inteligência artificial para reduzir fraudes, abusos e desperdícios em pagamentos de saúde. Acreditamos que a única maneira de alcançar isso é através de um time incrível, com pessoas apaixonadas por saúde e compradas na nossa missão de transformar o setor.


Perfil desejado

Buscamos uma pessoa cientista de dados com forte capacidade analítica, curiosidade e autonomia para explorar novos problemas e domínios. Alguém com perfil crítico e generalista, que se motive mais por entender e resolver problemas complexos com dados do que apenas por desenvolver modelos ou escrever código.

Procuramos alguém que combine rigor técnico e pensamento científico, com uma barra de qualidade alta. Que seja capaz de propor hipóteses, testar soluções de forma estruturada e entregar resultados robustos, bem validados e sustentáveis.


Responsabilidades

  • Analisar dados complexos e extrair insights que gerem valor para o negócio e para os clientes
  • Desenvolver relatórios, dashboards e visualizações de dados para comunicação de resultados
  • Identificar tendências, padrões e anomalias nos dados para apoiar a tomada de decisão estratégica
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes de engenharia de dados para garantir qualidade, integridade e acessibilidade dos dados
  • Criar e documentar métricas de desempenho e indicadores-chave para monitoramento dos processos
  • Apoiar na definição de requisitos e especificação de soluções baseadas em dados
  • Realizar estudos de viabilidade e análise de impacto de soluções propostas
  • Comunicar de forma clara e objetiva os achados analíticos para diferentes stakeholders


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Formação em Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou área correlata
  • Conhecimento em Python
  • Experiência com análise de dados e geração de insights acionáveis
  • Experiência em manipulação e consulta de bancos de dados SQL e não relacionais
  • Boa comunicação para interagir com diferentes stakeholders e traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções analíticas
  • Experiência com modelagem estatística ou machine learning.


Qualificações Desejadas

  • Experiência na área de healthtech
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de ETL
  • Familiaridade com Google Cloud (GCP) e BigQuery


Descrição da vaga

Essa pessoa será responsável por analisar dados complexos da carteira de clientes, identificar padrões e oportunidades e traduzir insights em recomendações estratégicas. Trabalhará em parceria com os times de Business e Health, desenvolvendo relatórios e dashboards que apoiem a tomada de decisão. Também atuará junto à engenharia de dados para garantir a qualidade e acessibilidade das informações, além de definir métricas e indicadores para monitorar o desempenho das iniciativas.


Benefícios

Plano de Saúde Bradesco Saúde Nacional II (TNMI)

VA/VR: R$1.080 no Flash

Acesso ao wellhub (gympass)

Vaga remota

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Senior Oracle Project Manager – Oracle ERP & Legacy Ecosystems


We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead complex, high-impact initiatives across Oracle ecosystems and legacy systems . This PM is focused on managing strategic improvement programs, regulatory adaptations (including Brazilian Tax Reform), system updates, enhancements, testing cycles, and the delivery of new functionalities in enterprise environments.


The ideal candidate demonstrates a proactive, dynamic, and ownership-driven mindset , with strong systemic and strategic vision, the ability to anticipate risks, and proven experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder projects.


Required Experience & Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Senior Project Manager in complex enterprise IT environments.
  • Strong background managing projects within Oracle ecosystems (Oracle EBS ERP and related solutions) and legacy systems .
  • Solid experience leading large-scale improvements, regulatory compliance initiatives, system upgrades, and testing programs .
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex stakeholder landscapes and executive-level communication.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end systems integration and dependency management .
  • Experience in environments with high regulatory and operational complexity .
  • Excellent leadership, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end project management for complex initiatives involving Oracle platforms and legacy systems .
  • Manage projects related to system improvements, regulatory adaptations (e.g., Tax Reform), upgrades, updates, testing cycles, and new functionality rollouts .
  • Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, IT teams, vendors, and executive leadership .
  • Drive governance, planning, execution, monitoring, and control of multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Anticipate risks, issues, and dependencies, proactively proposing mitigation strategies and corrective actions.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives, regulatory requirements, and technology solutions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional and multicultural teams, including internal teams, subcontractors, and partners.
  • Oversee scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk management.
  • Deliver clear, concise project communication, status reports, executive presentations, and decision papers.
  • Support strategic planning, roadmap definition, and prioritization of initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate governance, security, quality, and audit requirements.


Desired Profile

  • Proactive and dynamic professional with a strong sense of ownership .
  • Strategic mindset with strong systemic vision .
  • Ability to anticipate issues and risks before they materialize .
  • Results-driven, resilient, and adaptable to changing priorities.
  • Strong decision-making capability and accountability.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous and high-pressure environments.


Contract & Work Model

  • PJ (contractor) model
  • Long-term engagement: 1 year, renewable
  • Primarily remote, with sporadic national travel as needed

  • Apoiar e manter a documentação interna relacionada ao cliente
  • Apoiar a liderança da Avenue Code na tomada de decisões estratégicas



Requisitos

  • Experiência em consultoria de tecnologia e com contato direto com clientes

title: Vmware Consultant
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced VMware NSX Consultant to join our team on a contract basis. In this role, you will serve as a subject matter expert driving the architecture, deployment, and optimization of VMware NSX environments. You'll play a critical role in shaping network virtualization strategies, leading technical engagements, and delivering scalable, secure solutions across private and hybrid cloud infrastructures.

Responsibilities


Architecture & Deployment

  • Lead end-to-end architecture, design, and deployment of VMware NSX and Aria Operations for Networks
  • Design and implement multi-site architectures including network provisioning, workload management, configuration management, and disaster recovery strategies
  • Integrate NSX with third-party platforms spanning infrastructure, storage, networking, and security solutions


Operations & Management

  • Oversee deployment, configuration, and ongoing management of NSX and Aria Operations for Networks
  • Develop and enforce micro-segmentation policies to strengthen network security posture
  • Ensure adherence to industry standards, security policies, and compliance requirements


Collaboration & Leadership

  • Lead technical discussions, workshops, and knowledge transfer sessions for internal teams
  • Mentor junior consultants and provide guidance on troubleshooting and optimization
  • Participate in pre-sales engagements to scope and position NSX-based networking solutions
  • Develop and deliver technical documentation, design documents, and deployment best practices


Experience

  • 15+ years of hands-on technical experience with VMware and supporting technologies
  • 5+ years as a network engineer or architect
  • Proven experience deploying, upgrading, and managing NSX-T environments
  • Experience migrating NSX-V to NSX-T environments
  • Hands-on experience with Aria Operations for Networks (vRNI) for traffic analysis and micro-segmentation
  • Experience installing, configuring, and managing virtual networks and virtual load balancers
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment


Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to lead cross-functional technical discussions


Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field


Certifications

  • Required: VCP-NV
  • Preferred: VCP-DCV, VCP-CMA, VCAP-DCV, VCAP-CMA, VCDX-NV, VCP-VCF, VCAP-NV

title: Associate Account Executive - Biopharma
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as AbbVie, Astrazeneca, Pfizer, Merck. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


Our Biopharma team is growing, and we are looking for an experienced Associate Account Executive to expand institutional sales of our scientific video journal and databases to biopharma companies in North America. If you are ambitious, results-driven, and can develop relationships with scientists and progress opportunities, this position could be an excellent opportunity for you.


Responsibilities:


  • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing business for assigned biopharma accounts.
  • Conduct active outreach to build and progress opportunities in the pipeline to meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Build and execute a persistent outbound sales strategy, including cold calls and emails, to generate interest and accelerate new business generation.
  • Establish and maintain strong and professional relationships with biopharma librarians, R&D leadership and stakeholders.
  • Work with the marketing and customer success teams to customize marketing activities & provide support for each account.


Requirements:


  • A bachelor's degree
  • 2+ years of direct selling experience to stakeholders in the pharmaceutical, biotech, device, or healthcare industry.
  • Demonstrated success in meeting and exceeding sales objectives.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-makers and manage a full sales cycle.
  • Highly effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • A disciplined approach to daily activity planning, setting goals, and achieving success.
  • Experience with Salesforce or relevant sales CRM, MS Office is required.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package, including unlimited commissions.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and productivity.
  • Opportunity to work in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: AI Trainer
description:
We are looking for motivated individuals residing in Brazil to join our team as Freelance AI Trainers . This is an entry-level opportunity perfect for undergraduate students and freshers who are native Portuguese speakers and eager to contribute to the development of next-generation artificial intelligence.


Role Overview

As an AI Trainer, you will help improve the accuracy and quality of AI models by reviewing, labeling, and generating text-based content. Your insights as a native speaker are essential to ensuring the AI understands the nuances of the Portuguese language and Brazilian culture.


Key Responsibilities

  • Data Labeling: Categorize and annotate text data to help the AI understand context and intent.
  • Content Evaluation: Review AI-generated responses for accuracy, tone, and grammatical correctness.
  • Writing & Rewriting: Create high-quality sample dialogues or prompts in native Portuguese.
  • Fact-Checking: Verify information to ensure the AI provides reliable and safe responses.


Requirements

  • Language: Native-level proficiency in Portuguese (written and verbal).
  • Location: Must be a current resident of Brazil .
  • Education: Currently enrolled in an undergraduate program or a recent graduate (Freshers are encouraged to apply!).
  • Skills: Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and the ability to follow complex guidelines.
  • Tech Savvy: Comfortable working with online platforms and basic productivity tools.
  • Equipment: Access to a reliable computer and high-speed internet.


Compensation & Benefits


  • Rate: $4 USD per hour .
  • Flexibility: Work from anywhere in Brazil with a schedule that fits your studies or other commitments.
  • Experience: Gain hands-on experience in the rapidly growing field of Artificial Intelligence.

title: Staff Data Scientist
description:
Cientista de Dados


Sobre a Arvo

Temos o propósito de tornar a saúde no Brasil mais acessível para todos. Nossa jornada começa com o uso de dados e inteligência artificial para reduzir fraudes, abusos e desperdícios em pagamentos de saúde. Acreditamos que a única maneira de alcançar isso é através de um time incrível, com pessoas apaixonadas por saúde e compradas na nossa missão de transformar o setor.


Perfil desejado

Buscamos uma pessoa cientista de dados com forte capacidade analítica, curiosidade e autonomia para explorar novos problemas e domínios. Alguém com perfil crítico e generalista, que se motive mais por entender e resolver problemas complexos com dados do que apenas por desenvolver modelos ou escrever código.

Procuramos alguém que combine rigor técnico e pensamento científico, com uma barra de qualidade alta. Que seja capaz de propor hipóteses, testar soluções de forma estruturada e entregar resultados robustos, bem validados e sustentáveis.


Responsabilidades

  • Analisar dados complexos e extrair insights que gerem valor para o negócio e para os clientes
  • Desenvolver relatórios, dashboards e visualizações de dados para comunicação de resultados
  • Identificar tendências, padrões e anomalias nos dados para apoiar a tomada de decisão estratégica
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes de engenharia de dados para garantir qualidade, integridade e acessibilidade dos dados
  • Criar e documentar métricas de desempenho e indicadores-chave para monitoramento dos processos
  • Apoiar na definição de requisitos e especificação de soluções baseadas em dados
  • Realizar estudos de viabilidade e análise de impacto de soluções propostas
  • Comunicar de forma clara e objetiva os achados analíticos para diferentes stakeholders


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Formação em Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou área correlata
  • Conhecimento em Python
  • Experiência com análise de dados e geração de insights acionáveis
  • Experiência em manipulação e consulta de bancos de dados SQL e não relacionais
  • Boa comunicação para interagir com diferentes stakeholders e traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções analíticas
  • Experiência com modelagem estatística ou machine learning.


Qualificações Desejadas

  • Experiência na área de healthtech
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de ETL
  • Familiaridade com Google Cloud (GCP) e BigQuery


Descrição da vaga

Essa pessoa será responsável por analisar dados complexos da carteira de clientes, identificar padrões e oportunidades e traduzir insights em recomendações estratégicas. Trabalhará em parceria com os times de Business e Health, desenvolvendo relatórios e dashboards que apoiem a tomada de decisão. Também atuará junto à engenharia de dados para garantir a qualidade e acessibilidade das informações, além de definir métricas e indicadores para monitorar o desempenho das iniciativas.


Benefícios

Plano de Saúde Bradesco Saúde Nacional II (TNMI)

VA/VR: R$1.080 no Flash

Acesso ao wellhub (gympass)

Vaga remota

title: AI Trainer
description:
We are looking for motivated individuals residing in Brazil to join our team as Freelance AI Trainers . This is an entry-level opportunity perfect for undergraduate students and freshers who are native Portuguese speakers and eager to contribute to the development of next-generation artificial intelligence.


Role Overview

As an AI Trainer, you will help improve the accuracy and quality of AI models by reviewing, labeling, and generating text-based content. Your insights as a native speaker are essential to ensuring the AI understands the nuances of the Portuguese language and Brazilian culture.


Key Responsibilities

  • Data Labeling: Categorize and annotate text data to help the AI understand context and intent.
  • Content Evaluation: Review AI-generated responses for accuracy, tone, and grammatical correctness.
  • Writing & Rewriting: Create high-quality sample dialogues or prompts in native Portuguese.
  • Fact-Checking: Verify information to ensure the AI provides reliable and safe responses.


Requirements

  • Language: Native-level proficiency in Portuguese (written and verbal).
  • Location: Must be a current resident of Brazil .
  • Education: Currently enrolled in an undergraduate program or a recent graduate (Freshers are encouraged to apply!).
  • Skills: Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and the ability to follow complex guidelines.
  • Tech Savvy: Comfortable working with online platforms and basic productivity tools.
  • Equipment: Access to a reliable computer and high-speed internet.


Compensation & Benefits


  • Rate: $4 USD per hour .
  • Flexibility: Work from anywhere in Brazil with a schedule that fits your studies or other commitments.
  • Experience: Gain hands-on experience in the rapidly growing field of Artificial Intelligence.

title: Desenvolvedor Java Sênior
description:
Desenvolvedor Java Sênior


Como Desenvolvedor(a) Java Sênior , sua missão será atuar de ponta a ponta no desenvolvimento de soluções, participando da conceituação, desenvolvimento, testes e implantação de projetos existentes e de novas iniciativas.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Projetar e desenvolver aplicativos Web multiusuário eficientes, tanto para a execução no servidor como nos browsers, com possibilidades de instalação na nuvem;
  • Executar as atividades de todas as fases do ciclo do desenvolvimento e implantação dos aplicativos, usando metodologias ágeis;
  • Colaborar na definição da solução técnica aos requisitos de negócio, junto a área de produtos e junto aos clientes, implementando-a de forma eficiente e eficaz;
  • Criar códigos bem projetados, testáveis, eficientes, confiáveis, seguros e completamente aderentes às necessidades de negócio e com a arquitetura de referência corporativa. Aplicação de conceitos de reuso;
  • Desenvolver garantindo a qualidade e a manutenção do código, zelando pela documentação do mesmo e projetando/executando testes unitários e de integração.


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Graduação Completa em: Tecnologia da Informação, Desenvolvimento de Software, Análise de Sistemas, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas em TI.
  • Experiência de 6 anos em desenvolvimento de aplicação Web (Web App);
  • Linguagem de Programação Java ;
  • Desenvolvimento frontend JavaScript, HMTL, CSS. Jquery e React;
  • Capacidade de interpretação do código-fonte elaborado por outros;
  • Experiência em Cloud AWS;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de versionamento GIT;
  • APIs Rest;
  • Conhecimentos em bancos de dados SQL;
  • Maven;
  • Persistência Objeto-Relacional (Hibernate, JPA);



REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS


  • Sistema de Identidade (Ex: KeyCloak)
  • Bibliotecas de Log (Ex: Log4J);
  • Container (Docker);
  • Atuação com frameworks Spring (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring);
  • Ter atuado em projetos utilizando metodologia ágil Scrum

title: Delivery Manager (Internacional)
description:
A Avenue Code é uma consultoria global de tecnologia especializada em transformação digital, desenvolvimento de software e soluções de alta performance para grandes empresas ao redor do mundo. Fazemos parte da AI/R Company , um ecossistema global de inovação que conecta tecnologia, dados e inteligência artificial para impulsionar negócios.


Sobre a posição:

Você irá atuar como Delivery Manager em um cliente internacional, sendo facilitador entre times técnicos e stakeholders. Essa pessoa é responsável por garantir a excelência na entrega, remover impedimentos, apoiar decisões estratégicas e assegurar que a cultura, os objetivos e a estratégia do cliente sejam bem compreendidos e disseminados dentro do time. Além disso, o papel tem forte atuação em gestão de pessoas, acompanhamento de performance e relacionamento com o cliente, contribuindo para a saúde da conta e identificação de oportunidades de negócio.


Responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar e garantir a performance dos times alocados no cliente
  • Atuar como ponto focal do cliente para temas relacionados à entrega
  • Conduzir reuniões recorrentes com clientes (status, performance, riscos e alinhamentos)
  • Elaborar e acompanhar relatórios de performance, KPIs, riscos e indicadores da conta
  • Conduzir processos de onboarding do time (Avenue Code e cliente)
  • Realizar entrevistas com foco em culture fit
  • Conduzir avaliações de desempenho, feedbacks contínuos e reuniões 1:1
  • Criar e acompanhar planos de desenvolvimento individuais (PDI)
  • Apoiar ações de retenção, promoções, negociações e movimentações internas
  • Controlar horas trabalhadas e apoiar a gestão de capacidade do time
  • Atuar em reuniões de attrition e análise de riscos de turnover
  • Apoiar e manter a documentação interna relacionada ao cliente
  • Apoiar a liderança da Avenue Code na tomada de decisões estratégicas



Requisitos

  • Inglês avançado ou fluente (excelente comunicação verbal e escrita)
  • Experiência em gestão de pessoas
  • Experiência em consultoria de tecnologia e com contato direto com clientes
  • Background técnico em desenvolvimento de software
  • Habilidade de negociação
  • Experiência com relatórios de performance e indicadores de negócio


Desejáveis

  • Experiência com vendas ou suporte à área comercial
  • Conhecimento em OKRs
  • Experiência com métricas de performance
  • Familiaridade com NPS



A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.
