Contratação: PJ


Buscamos por um(a) Senior Data Scientist para atuar em projetos estratégicos de dados, com foco em modelagem preditiva, inferência causal e geração de insights para tomada de decisão.

– Atuar no entendimento de problemas de negócio e tradução para soluções analíticas;

– Inglês avançado.

description:

title: Analista de RevOps
description:
Junte-se à transformação da saúde no Brasil com a Salux Technology!


A Salux Technology é uma HealthTech 100% brasileira pioneira em soluções inovadoras de gestão de saúde. Desde 1997, nossa missão tem sido democratizar a excelência em saúde, ajudando mais de 250 clientes em todo o país a alcançar resultados excepcionais ao aprimorar a gestão administrativa e clínica.


Em 2021, a Salux passou a fazer parte do Grupo SBPar, o que acelerou nossa jornada de expansão e inovação, consolidando nossa posição como referência em excelência na informatização e soluções tecnológicas para o setor de saúde.


Se você é movido por desafios e quer fazer a diferença em um ambiente dinâmico e em constante evolução, venha crescer conosco e impactar positivamente o futuro da saúde no Brasil!


Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Estruturar e otimizar a operação de Revenue Operations, garantindo eficiência e previsibilidade de receita;
  • Mapear e evoluir o funil ponta a ponta (pipeline, fechamento, onboarding, retenção e expansão);
  • Padronizar processos entre Vendas e Customer Success e identificar oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Implementar automações ao longo da jornada do cliente, aumentando produtividade e reduzindo atividades manuais;
  • Integrar ferramentas (CRM, CS, BI) garantindo consistência e qualidade dos dados;
  • Acompanhar e estruturar indicadores de receita (conversão, churn, NRR, LTV, CAC) e apoiar forecast;
  • Desenvolver dashboards e gerar insights para tomada de decisão;
  • Aplicar IA para ganho de produtividade, análise de dados e identificação de riscos e oportunidades;
  • Apoiar Vendas e CS na eficiência do pipeline, gestão da base e expansão;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com áreas como Produto, Marketing, Vendas e Customer Success.


Requisitos Técnicos:


  • Superior completo em Administração, Marketing, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas e afins;
  • Experiência prévia em Revenue Operations, CS Ops, Sales Ops ou áreas correlatas;
  • Forte domínio de CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce ou similares);
  • Experiência com automação de processos (workflows, integrações);
  • Conhecimento sólido de métricas de receita (churn, NRR, LTV, CAC, conversão);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, Looker ou similares);
  • Experiência prática no uso de IA aplicada a negócios.


Modalidade de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ).

Modelo de trabalho: Atuação híbrida em São Paulo ou Porto Alegre, com possibilidade de trabalho remoto para demais regiões.

title: AI Trainer - Advanced Japanese Fluency
description:
AI Trainer - Advanced Japanese Fluency


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The role

We’re looking for Advanced Japanese Speakers to help train and evaluate cutting-edge AI models. If you have the necessary experience, we’ll send you a quick test to assess your skills and suitability for AI tasks. If successful, you’ll be invited to join Prolific as a Domain Expert participant, where you’ll get paid to train and evaluate powerful AI models.


Researchers looking for your skills tend to pay $20-30/hr per AI task completed. You must be prepared to complete paid tasks that require one hour of uninterrupted work, though many are shorter.


What you’ll bring

  • Advanced language skills and verifiable experience as being fluent in Japanese.
  • Fluency in English (B2+)
  • A willingness to take our skills verification test to assess your suitability for our Domain Expert participant pool
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to concentrate on complex tasks for up to one hour at a time
  • A reliable and fast internet connection and access to a computer
  • A willingness to self-declare your earnings, as our participants are self-employed
  • A Paypal account to receive payment from our clients


What you’ll be doing in the role

  • Completing AI training tasks such as analyzing, editing, and writing in Japanese
  • Judging the performance of AI in performing Japanese prompts
  • Improving cutting-edge AI models


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant

Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using professional legal expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.


Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again; simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
About us:

Closir is a UK-based investor relations (IR) support services provider. For over a decade we have been entrusted by blue chip companies around the world to help them achieve their IR objectives due to our intimate knowledge of the global buy-side, our technological expertise, and our close, long-term partnership approach.

The Closir platform is an all-in-one, web-based solution which makes companies much smarter and more effective, by helping them to achieve their IR objectives intelligently and proactively.

Closir combines all elements of IR, from high-level strategy (“Who’s investing in my peers?”) to daily workflow (“What topics came up most in my meetings with investors this quarter?”) into one intelligent, user-friendly platform which includes the most comprehensive and up-to-date database of buy-side contacts on the market; proactive outreach tools; share & peer holder tracking; customisable reports; and professional-level support.


Role Overview:

We are looking for a customer-centric, self-driven individual to join our Customer Success team.


You will manage relationships with IR teams at public companies, guiding them from onboarding through to long-term adoption. You’ll help clients integrate their data, extract insights, and embed Closir into their day-to-day workflows.


You will work closely with Research and Product teams to ensure high-quality data integration, surface client feedback, and improve the experience on Closir.com.


Responsibilities:


  • Partner with clients to understand their Investor Relations needs and drive adoption of the Closir platform.
  • Act as a trusted advisor, providing strategic insights and support to senior IR teams.
  • Deliver tailored onboarding, training, and consulting sessions.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to champion client feedback and influence product direction.
  • Build long-lasting relationships that foster retention, growth, and client advocacy.



Qualifications:


  • Background in Investor Relations (in-house or advisory) – you understand the workflows, challenges, and priorities of IR professionals.
  • Experience in consulting, customer success, or client-facing roles where you’ve advised senior stakeholders.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex needs into actionable solutions.
  • Passion for SaaS, fintech, and improving how companies engage with investors.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish



Why Join Us?


  • Work at the intersection of SaaS, finance, and strategy with a fast-growing, global team.
  • Shape the future of investor relations technology.
  • Opportunity to take ownership and make a measurable impact with clients.
  • Collaborative, ambitious, and supportive culture.



If you’re excited about helping Investor Relations teams thrive with cutting-edge SaaS solutions, we’d love to hear from you.


This job vacancy is open for candidates based out of Latin America.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
About Turnkey

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software.

The TurnKey team is growing fast and worldwide! We have employees located in Eastern European countries and Latin America (Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, and Uruguay). We continue scaling remote software development teams for more than 30+ US-based enterprises and start-ups, including Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, Ironclad, BellXcel, etc. At TurnKey, we’re the ultimate matchmakers for US-based companies, creating remote dream teams.


Role Overview

We’re looking for a driven and detail-oriented Technical Recruiter to join our growing team. You will play a key role in sourcing and recruiting top tech and non-tech talent across Europe and Latin America , partnering closely with hiring managers and candidates to ensure an excellent recruitment experience from start to finish.


Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with internal teams and clients to understand hiring needs and role requirements
  • Source, screen, and engage candidates for a variety of technical and non-technical roles
  • Manage full-cycle recruitment: job posting, sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, collecting feedback, and offer negotiation
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for high-demand positions
  • Ensure a smooth and timely candidate experience, keeping stakeholders informed throughout the process
  • Collaborate with team members and hiring managers to continuously improve processes
  • Maintain accurate data in our applicant tracking systems and internal reports
  • Stay updated on regional hiring trends and market insights across Europe and LATAM


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles.
  • Strong knowledge of IT roles, technologies, and industry trends.
  • Familiarity with both technical and non-technical profiles
  • Solid sourcing skills and experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and other sourcing tools
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Experience hiring in Latin America
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first environment
  • Upper-Intermediate + level of English
  • Readiness to work in various time zones according to the candidates’ time zone


Why You Should Work at TurnKey:

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team.
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks);
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Free advanced English lessons with a budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work;
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes.
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together.
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise.

title: Project Manager (experience w/ EDI)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Academic background in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a Senior IT Project Manager with a minimum of 8 years of experience in managing complex IT projects.
  • Proven expertise in leading global E-Invoicing programs, EDI, or tax-driven IT solutions, ensuring legal compliance across multiple countries and SAP landscapes (S/4HANA and ECC).
  • Experience in driving global XSTORE upgrade projects (preferably V25), enabling standardized retail setups.

title: Project Manager - Digital Technology
description:
Project Manager - Digital Technology


Job Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Digital Technology (DT) Project Manager to join our team. The DT Project Manager will be responsible for planning, leading, organizing, and motivating project teams to achieve a high level of performance and quality in delivering projects that provide exceptional business value to users. This role requires a high degree of collaboration with leaders across the organization.

  • Key Responsibilities:Project Planning and Management: Full project life cycle ownership: successful project delivery will include full implementation from initiation to deployment.


  • Scope, Schedule, and Resource Management: Manage all aspects of projects including scope, schedule, resources, quality, costs, change, and risk to ensure the overall program is aligned to and directly supports the achievement of strategic objectives.


  • Financial Management: Oversee project budgets, track expenditures, and ensure financial objectives are met. Provide regular financial reports and forecasts to stakeholders.


  • Project Monitoring & Control: Prepare estimates and detailed project plan for all phases of the project. Manage the day-to-day project activities and resources.


  • Transparency and Reporting: Provide status reporting regarding project milestones, deliverable, dependencies, risks & issues, communicating across leadership.


  • Agile Practices: Organize and facilitate release planning, daily stand-up meetings, and reviews. Track and communicate scrum metrics including team velocity and sprint/release progress.


  • Quality Management: Manage ongoing quality control and participate in quality issue resolution.


  • Risk Management: Identify and manage project risks and issues, and develop mitigation plans
  • Experience and Skills: Experience in Agile & Waterfall methodologies.


  • Excellent communication (written, verbal and presentation) and interpersonal skills.


  • Experience in successfully leading projects and programs to from initiation to closure.


  • Experience working both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.


  • Experience partnering with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and technical teams.


  • Flexible with proven ability to conform to shifting priorities, demands and timelines through analytical and problem-solving capabilities.


  • Flexible work hours when needed to align with counterparts at other Otis locations.


  • Support diverse and inclusive work environment.


  • Bachelor's Degree of Computer Science, IT, MIS or equivalent work experience.


  • Minimum of 5 years of hands-on project management experience, including initiating, tracking and planning projects.


  • Intermediate level of proficiency with MS Office, MS Project, PPM and Agile tools.


  • PMP Certification required. Agile certifications are highly desirable

title: Product Owner
description:
A Airswift está com uma nova oportunidade para Product Owner, para atuar em um cliente global do setor de energia, em aplicações utilizadas por times de negócios em diferentes regiões do mundo.


Sobre a posição

O profissional será responsável por apoiar a transição e sustentação de duas aplicações.

Essas aplicações estão em um plano de descontinuação e, portanto, o foco da posição será:

  • Suporte operacional
  • Manutenção
  • Estabilidade das aplicações
  • Apoio à transição para futuras soluções que irão substituí-las
  • Não haverá desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades.


Responsabilidades

  • Criar user stories e critérios de aceite claros e completos.
  • Priorizar e manter o backlog alinhado à visão do produto e ao roadmap.
  • Participar de cerimônias ágeis, apoiando o time na entrega.
  • Colaborar com arquitetos e times técnicos na definição de demandas técnicas e de infraestrutura.
  • Balancear entregas, dívida técnica e melhorias necessárias.
  • Garantir que as entregas gerem valor real ao negócio.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o Delivery Team e o Scrum Master no planejamento e execução.
  • Atuar como a voz do cliente, entendendo continuamente as necessidades do negócio.
  • Interagir com usuários para análise de demandas e alinhamento de expectativas.
  • Apoiar o Program Team em roadmap e planos de release.
  • Colaborar com outros Product Owners para gerenciamento de dependências.
  • Proteger o time de interrupções fora de escopo durante os sprints.
  • Criar e gerenciar tickets de atendimento para clientes finais.


Requisitos

  • Experiência como Product Owner
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis .
  • Inglês avançado/fluente – todas as interações serão realizadas em inglês.
  • Forte capacidade de:
  • Entendimento do negócio
  • Comunicação clara
  • Experiência ou familiaridade com:
  • Zendesk
  • Amazon Connect
  • Sistemas internos / soluções customizadas (diferencial)

Modelo de trabalho

  • Híbrido, caso profissional seja de Curitiba (diferencial) ou Remoto
  • Horário: 8h às 17h
  • Início: previsão final de Março 2026

description:

title: Product Owner
description:
A Airswift está com uma nova oportunidade para Product Owner, para atuar em um cliente global do setor de energia, em aplicações utilizadas por times de negócios em diferentes regiões do mundo.


Sobre a posição

O profissional será responsável por apoiar a transição e sustentação de duas aplicações.

Essas aplicações estão em um plano de descontinuação e, portanto, o foco da posição será:

  • Suporte operacional
  • Manutenção
  • Estabilidade das aplicações
  • Apoio à transição para futuras soluções que irão substituí-las
  • Não haverá desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades.


Responsabilidades

  • Criar user stories e critérios de aceite claros e completos.
  • Priorizar e manter o backlog alinhado à visão do produto e ao roadmap.
  • Participar de cerimônias ágeis, apoiando o time na entrega.
  • Colaborar com arquitetos e times técnicos na definição de demandas técnicas e de infraestrutura.
  • Balancear entregas, dívida técnica e melhorias necessárias.
  • Garantir que as entregas gerem valor real ao negócio.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o Delivery Team e o Scrum Master no planejamento e execução.
  • Atuar como a voz do cliente, entendendo continuamente as necessidades do negócio.
  • Interagir com usuários para análise de demandas e alinhamento de expectativas.
  • Apoiar o Program Team em roadmap e planos de release.
  • Colaborar com outros Product Owners para gerenciamento de dependências.
  • Proteger o time de interrupções fora de escopo durante os sprints.
  • Criar e gerenciar tickets de atendimento para clientes finais.


Requisitos

  • Experiência como Product Owner
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis .
  • Inglês avançado/fluente – todas as interações serão realizadas em inglês.
  • Forte capacidade de:
  • Entendimento do negócio
  • Comunicação clara
  • Experiência ou familiaridade com:
  • Zendesk
  • Amazon Connect
  • Sistemas internos / soluções customizadas (diferencial)

Modelo de trabalho

  • Híbrido, caso profissional seja de Curitiba (diferencial) ou Remoto
  • Horário: 8h às 17h
  • Início: previsão final de Março 2026

title: Project Manager - Digital Technology
description:
Project Manager - Digital Technology


Job Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Digital Technology (DT) Project Manager to join our team. The DT Project Manager will be responsible for planning, leading, organizing, and motivating project teams to achieve a high level of performance and quality in delivering projects that provide exceptional business value to users. This role requires a high degree of collaboration with leaders across the organization.

  • Key Responsibilities:Project Planning and Management: Full project life cycle ownership: successful project delivery will include full implementation from initiation to deployment.


  • Scope, Schedule, and Resource Management: Manage all aspects of projects including scope, schedule, resources, quality, costs, change, and risk to ensure the overall program is aligned to and directly supports the achievement of strategic objectives.


  • Financial Management: Oversee project budgets, track expenditures, and ensure financial objectives are met. Provide regular financial reports and forecasts to stakeholders.


  • Project Monitoring & Control: Prepare estimates and detailed project plan for all phases of the project. Manage the day-to-day project activities and resources.


  • Transparency and Reporting: Provide status reporting regarding project milestones, deliverable, dependencies, risks & issues, communicating across leadership.


  • Agile Practices: Organize and facilitate release planning, daily stand-up meetings, and reviews. Track and communicate scrum metrics including team velocity and sprint/release progress.


  • Quality Management: Manage ongoing quality control and participate in quality issue resolution.


  • Risk Management: Identify and manage project risks and issues, and develop mitigation plans
  • Experience and Skills: Experience in Agile & Waterfall methodologies.


  • Excellent communication (written, verbal and presentation) and interpersonal skills.


  • Experience in successfully leading projects and programs to from initiation to closure.


  • Experience working both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.


  • Experience partnering with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and technical teams.


  • Flexible with proven ability to conform to shifting priorities, demands and timelines through analytical and problem-solving capabilities.


  • Flexible work hours when needed to align with counterparts at other Otis locations.


  • Support diverse and inclusive work environment.


  • Bachelor's Degree of Computer Science, IT, MIS or equivalent work experience.


  • Minimum of 5 years of hands-on project management experience, including initiating, tracking and planning projects.


  • Intermediate level of proficiency with MS Office, MS Project, PPM and Agile tools.


  • PMP Certification required. Agile certifications are highly desirable

title: Veterinary Radiologist
description:
Veterinary Radiologist - Remote


About SignalPET


SignalPET is a pioneering technology company reshaping veterinary medicine through AI-powered radiograph interpretation. Our mission is to provide fast, accurate, and accessible diagnostic insights to veterinarians around the world.


Role Overview


We are seeking experienced Veterinary Radiologists based in Brazil to join us. In this 100% remote role, you will review AI-assisted radiographic studies, validate findings, and support clinical quality initiatives. This is a unique chance to combine your clinical expertise with innovative technology on a global scale.


Key Responsibilities


  • Review and interpret routine small-animal radiographic studies.
  • Validate the accuracy of AI-generated reports.
  • Provide expert insights and feedback on reported cases.
  • Collaborate with veterinarians and fellow radiologists worldwide.
  • Participate in quality control and system enhancement projects.
  • Stay informed on developments in diagnostic imaging and veterinary AI.


Qualifications


  • Médico Veterinário with specialization in Diagnóstico por Imagem or Radiologia Veterinária .
  • M.V., MSc or M.V., PhD preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in small animal diagnostic imaging.
  • Strong diagnostic and communication skills.
  • Proficient in English (written and spoken).
  • Self-motivated, reliable, and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable working independently and remotely.


What We Offer


  • Fully remote role (Brazil-based).
  • Supportive, international team and culture.
  • Full training provided—no prior AI experience required.
  • A meaningful opportunity to shape the future of veterinary diagnostics.



*** IMPORTANT NOTICE ***


This role has had to be re-advertised due to candidates not responding to LinkedIn messages sent to arrange interviews.


Please ensure that you check your LinkedIn messages daily and respond promptly. Failure to respond may result in your application not being considered further.


We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to hearing from responsive candidates.

title: React Developer
description:
Job Title: React Developer

Duration : 5-month contract (until September 2026)

Location: Remote (US East Coast working hours)

(This role is CLT only. If you are not open to this, this role will not be a fit at this time)


Qualifications:

• 3+ years of professional experience as a Front-End Developer

• Strong JavaScript expertise, including ReactJS, HTML, and CSS, with a focus on refactoring and component modifications

• Experience with JavaServer Pages (JSP) for developing server-side components and supporting legacy UI development


Overview: You’ll work in a swarm model, focusing the team on one priority product at a time to deliver measurable ADA/WCAG accessibility improvements before moving on to the next. This is a fully front-end role, where you’ll develop and refine ReactJS, HTML, and CSS components, ensure compliance with accessibility standards, and support legacy UI by working with JSPs or similar technologies. You’ll collaborate closely with product, UX, and engineering teams to implement pre written accessibility requirements, validate outcomes against VPAT, and document improvements. Daily responsibilities include participating in standups, using GitHub workflows for pull requests and code reviews, proactively surfacing risks or blockers, and helping modernize UI components while maintaining legacy systems, all while tracking progress toward accessibility goals.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join our growing DevOps team in Brazil. You’ll work closely with international engineering teams, helping to design, automate, and operate reliable, secure, and scalable systems in a production-critical environment.


This is a hands-on role with end-to-end ownership , exposure to modern DevOps tooling, and opportunities to mentor junior engineers while contributing to platform stability and continuous improvement.


Your role and responsabilities:


  • Design, maintain, and enhance CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions
  • Manage and support deployments across:
  • OpenShift / Kubernetes
  • AWS
  • Bare-metal infrastructure (low-latency systems)
  • Automate infrastructure and application configuration using Ansible
  • Support and troubleshoot Unix/Linux systems , with integration into Windows environments
  • Implement monitoring and observability using:
  • Dynatrace (system monitoring and alerting)
  • ELK Stack (centralized logging)
  • Collaborate with engineering teams using GitHub , Jira , and Confluence
  • Participate in release activities, including:
  • Planned deployments
  • Post-release verification
  • Incident investigation and root cause analysis
  • Join a rotational weekend release schedule (approx. 1 weekend in every 5)
  • Mentor and support the development of junior DevOps engineers
  • Leverage AI-assisted tools (GitHub Copilot, Rovo, Devin) to improve delivery and operational efficiency
  • Continuously improve documentation, standards, and DevOps best practices


Requirements and Qualifications:


  • Advanced English
  • Strong Unix/Linux administration experience
  • Ansible : solid experience writing and maintaining playbooks and roles
  • Git : confident using collaborative workflows
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins and/or GitHub Actions)
  • Experience running workloads on Kubernetes / OpenShift
  • Scripting or coding skills (Bash, Python, or similar )
  • Experience supporting production systems


Nice to Have


  • AWS experience
  • Exposure to bare-metal infrastructure
  • ELK Stack administration
  • Dynatrace configuration and dashboarding
  • Windows Server administration
  • Experience in banking, finance, or FX
  • Exposure to regulated environments
  • Experience working in Kanban teams


Please submit resumé in English

Na Jaya Tech , acreditamos na Engenharia de Software Consciente, uma abordagem inovadora, e por isso oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho inspirador, focado em promover o autoconhecimento, tomar decisões embasadas em dados, cultivar relacionamentos saudáveis e entender o impacto do nosso trabalho. - Abertura para atuar em ambiente multistack (Python e Node.js), contribuindo com qualidade nas duas tecnologias conforme a necessidade do time

- Postura colaborativa, com foco no sucesso coletivo e na entrega consistente do time

- Inglês Fluente

Diferenciais:

- Experiência com microsserviços, segurança em APIs e padrões de contratos de API

- Experiência com processamento e manipulação de dados geoespaciais utilizando Python (GeoPandas, Shapely, Rasterio)


Por que essa vaga pode ser ideal pra você?

title: Consultor(a) SAP SD Sênior
description:
Sobre a Motivus


Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Com mais de 1.600 colaboradores em 5 países, oferecemos um amplo espectro de serviços de software e soluções digitais. Nossas equipes são dedicadas a impulsionar a sustentabilidade, expandir os limites da tecnologia e construir a próxima geração de soluções digitais de classe mundial que capacitam nossos clientes e geram impacto duradouro. Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você trabalhará com profissionais visionários comprometidos em criar soluções inovadoras que moldam o futuro da indústria.


Visão Geral da Posição


Estamos em busca de um(a) Consultor(a) SAP SD Sênior para se juntar à nossa equipe dinâmica. Nesse cargo, você será responsável por desenhar e implementar soluções funcionais no módulo SD, assegurando que os processos de negócio sejam atendidos de forma eficiente e alinhada às estratégias da organização. Você colaborará com equipes diversificadas, incentivará a comunicação multifuncional e contribuirá para projetos que terão um impacto significativo em nossos clientes e na indústria.


Responsabilidades


  • Conduzir levantamento de requisitos e elaborar o desenho de soluções funcionais;
  • Realizar parametrizações, testes e suporte pós-go-live;
  • Garantir o alinhamento entre áreas de negócio e TI, atuando de forma colaborativa;
  • Apoiar projetos de S/4HANA, integrações e iniciativas de melhorias contínuas.


Conhecimentos Técnicos


  • Domínio completo dos processos SAP SD (vendas, faturamento, pricing, shipping, impostos);
  • Experiência em projetos end-to-end e metodologias ágeis;
  • Vivência com S/4HANA será considerada um diferencial.


Requisitos


  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência como Consultor(a) SAP SD;
  • Participação comprovada em implementações completas;
  • Perfil colaborativo, ágil e orientado a resultados;
  • Inglês técnico (desejável fluência em inglês ou espanhol).



Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?


  • Desenvolva sua Carreira: Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes: Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer - (Vue / Node.js)
description:
This is a 100% Remote Independent Contractor Role.


About Equate Media

Equate Media is a growth-focused digital company that builds software and operational systems designed to improve efficiency, support customer engagement, and drive measurable business results. Our teams work closely across engineering, marketing, and operations to solve practical problems, improve workflows, and create systems that make a real impact. We value speed, ownership, adaptability, and people who enjoy building useful things in a fast-moving environment.


About the role

We’re hiring a Senior Full Stack Developer to help strengthen and expand a real-time communications platform used every day by the business. This person will step into an existing production environment, work through active issues, improve platform reliability, and help push new functionality into production quickly.


The work touches both frontend and backend systems tied to inbound and outbound call activity, routing logic, internal buffering, operational tooling, and live user workflows. This is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving real production problems, working across the stack, and making meaningful contributions without a lot of hand-holding.


Where you’ll make an impact

  • Get up to speed quickly in an existing multi-service production platform
  • Investigate and resolve issues across frontend, backend, and third-party integrations
  • Deliver new features at a high pace while keeping stability and maintainability in mind
  • Improve systems that support real-time call flows, routing behavior, and internal buffering
  • Build and refine interfaces used for live operations and communication workflows
  • Develop backend services, APIs, and platform functionality tied directly to business performance
  • Help improve visibility, reliability, and overall behavior in a live production environment
  • Contribute to engineering decisions and help raise execution standards across the team


Tools and environment

  • Frontend: Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, Pinia, Vue Router
  • Backend: Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Express
  • Real-time / Communications: Socket.IO, WebRTC, browser based calling with Twilio/Sinch/similar system
  • Infrastructure / Services: AWS, Redis, RabbitMQ / AMQP, PM2
  • Monitoring / Error Tracking: Sentry


What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience as a full stack software developer
  • Strong backend experience with Node.js
  • Strong frontend experience with Vue, or strong experience with a modern frontend framework and the ability to work confidently in a Vue codebase
  • Experience working in existing production systems, not only creating from scratch
  • Ability to troubleshoot across the stack and solve real-world issues efficiently
  • Experience shipping features quickly in fast-moving environments
  • Strong instincts around performance, reliability, and maintainability
  • Comfortable taking ownership and operating independently
  • Experience with AWS or other cloud-based production environments
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams


Bonus Points For

  • Telephony, VoIP, call routing, or communications platforms
  • Twilio, Sinch, or similar providers
  • Real-time systems, event-driven architecture, queues, or worker-based services
  • Redis, RabbitMQ, or live operational workflows
  • Improving legacy systems while continuing to ship new functionality
  • Exposure to AI-assisted workflows such as transcription, summarization, or automation


Why this role stands out

This is an opportunity to work on a live platform that supports real operational activity and directly impacts the business. You’ll be solving practical problems, improving systems that people rely on every day, and helping shape what gets built next. If you enjoy working in production systems, fixing meaningful problems, and shipping useful features quickly, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Arquiteto de Software
description:
A VMetrix é uma empresa SaaS que desenvolve uma plataforma financeira integral utilizada por bancos, fundos de pensão, gestoras de fundos, corretoras e asset managers no Chile e na América Latina. Nossa plataforma cobre o ciclo completo de gestão de investimentos: desde a captura de operações e gestão do ciclo de vida transacional, até a precificação, contabilidade, risco de mercado, compliance regulatório e reporting.


Propósito do Cargo

Arquiteto de Software é responsável por definir, evoluir e governar a arquitetura técnica da plataforma VMetrix . Este papel atua como ponte entre os requisitos de negócio financeiro, as restrições regulatórias e a implementação técnica, garantindo que as decisões arquiteturais suportem a escalabilidade, manutenibilidade e compliance da plataforma a longo prazo. Lidera o design dos sistemas mais complexos, estabelece os padrões técnicos para toda a equipe de desenvolvimento e governa a adoção estratégica de ferramentas de IA no ciclo de engenharia.


Responsabilidades Principais:


Desenvolvimento e Manutenção da Plataforma

  • Desenvolver e manter módulos core da plataforma: ciclo de vida transacional (captura, validação, aprovação, liquidação), precificação de instrumentos, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado e reporting regulatório.
  • Implementar lógica de negócio financeiro complexa: processos de precificação mark-to-market, cálculos de P&L, accruals, amortizações, simulações end-of-day e processos batch de fechamento.
  • Escrever código bem estruturado, eficiente, testável e aderente aos padrões arquiteturais definidos pela equipe de Arquitetura.
  • Identificar bugs, gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria na base de código, propondo e implementando soluções com foco em qualidade e manutenibilidade.
  • Antecipar necessidades futuras do sistema, sendo proativo na identificação de riscos técnicos e propondo soluções antes que se tornem impedimentos.


Arquitetura de Dados e PL/SQL

  • Projetar e otimizar procedures PL/SQL em Oracle 21c, incluindo pipelined functions, estratégias com Global Temporary Tables e packages de cálculo financeiro.
  • Construir APIs REST robustas para integração com sistemas externos (ERPs, sistemas contábeis, provedores de dados de mercado), cobrindo múltiplas classes de ativos.
  • Participar no design de motores genéricos com arquitetura metadata-driven, múltiplas estratégias de execução e cache de alto desempenho.


Qualidade, Testes e Revisão de Código

  • Analisar, depurar e testar software de forma sistemática, garantindo conformidade com as especificações técnicas definidas.
  • Realizar revisões de código com foco em qualidade, segurança, performance e aderência aos padrões arquiteturais da plataforma.
  • Definir e aplicar estratégias de testes (unitários, integração, contrato) em colaboração com o time de Arquitetura.
  • Garantir que os módulos desenvolvidos sejam seguros, estáveis e aderentes às exigências regulatórias dos mercados atendidos.


Colaboração Técnica e Mentoria

  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o Arquiteto de Software e Tech Leads para o cumprimento das diretrizes técnicas e das demandas da área.
  • Realizar mentoria técnica de desenvolvedores juniores e plenos: revisões de design, pair programming e transferência de conhecimento do domínio financeiro.
  • Participar ativamente de reuniões técnicas de equipe para discussão e alinhamento de demandas, soluções e prioridades.
  • Monitorar tendências e tecnologias, contribuindo com propostas de melhoria de processos e ferramentas utilizadas no desenvolvimento dos produtos da empresa.


Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA

  • Utilizar ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) de forma produtiva e responsável no ciclo diário de desenvolvimento: geração de código, revisão, debugging e escrita de testes.
  • Elaborar e consumir especificações técnicas otimizadas para uso com LLMs, garantindo que a documentação sirva tanto para a equipe quanto como contexto de alta qualidade para ferramentas de IA generativa.
  • Aplicar engenharia de prompts no contexto de desenvolvimento: formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Formação acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou certificações técnicas relevantes são diferenciais.
  • 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Domínio avançado de Java 8+ e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, transações, testes).
  • Experiência sólida em Oracle Database (PL/SQL, pipelined functions, partitioning, performance tuning, schemas complexos).
  • Conhecimento prático de Kubernetes (OKE) e deployments em containers (Docker, WebLogic em OKE).
  • Experiência com padrões de arquitetura: metadata-driven designs, cache distribuído (Caffeine/Redis), event-driven, repository pattern.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento modernas: Git e Git Flow, pipelines CI/CD, Postman/OpenAPI.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou similares — incluindo uso em geração de código, escrita de testes, refatoração e debugging.
  • Capacidade de engenharia de prompts aplicada ao desenvolvimento: saber formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem.
  • Capacidade de ler e produzir especificações técnicas detalhadas em formato Markdown.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento do domínio financeiro: renda fixa, renda variável, derivativos, fundos de investimento, gestão de portfólios, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado.
  • Experiência com regulação financeira brasileira ou latino-americana (CVM, BACEN, ANBIMA, ou órgãos equivalentes).
  • Experiência com integrações Office (Excel Add-ins) para plataformas SaaS financeiras.
  • Familiaridade com padrões da indústria financeira (FpML, ISDA, ou outros).
  • Experiência com observabilidade: Grafana, métricas de aplicação, alerting.
  • Conhecimento de práticas GitOps e versionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC).
  • Familiaridade com testes de contrato (contract testing) e testes de integração em arquiteturas de microsserviços.
  • Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações equivalentes em tecnologias do stack.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas de tecnologia, engenharia ou gestão de inovação.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Flutter/Node.js)
description:
About the Company:

Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.


Role Description:

Headspace is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack with Flutter focus) to support our Employer Solutions team. This team builds the foundational capabilities that power our commercial partnerships by enabling hundreds of employers to offer Headspace as a benefit to their workforce. This assignment supports development and delivery of scalable, high-quality mobile systems and features, ensuring they integrate seamlessly with our backend services and bring Headspace’s mission to life.


Deliverables:

  • Design and develop maintainable and flexible services for mission-critical systems that directly support mental healthcare delivery.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to gather requirements and write RFCs and technical specifications to solve technical and business problems end to end.
  • Effectively communicate technical ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Use business and technical knowledge to recommend thoughtful tradeoffs between complexity, quality, and delivery speed.
  • Maintain high standards for documentation, code quality, code reviews and operational excellence.
  • Contribute to and influence system architecture decisions, product quality and SLA targets.
  • Apply best practices in testing, monitoring, alerting, and observability.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • 2+ years of experience developing with Flutter, including familiarity with Flutter frameworks, third-party libraries, and APIs.
  • 2+ years of experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, with a strong understanding of design patterns.
  • Proficiency with mobile architecture and design patterns (e.g., MVC, MVVM).
  • Experience designing reliable, scalable microservices architectures.
  • Proficiency with Git version control systems and other essential mobile development tools.
  • Experience writing robust unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, including edge-case handling, using API testing frameworks/tools (e.g., Jest, Gatling, Playwright).
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver in a fast-paced, Agile environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively partner with product managers, designers, and engineers in a remote-friendly environment.
  • Track record of delivering complex projects across product and technology initiatives.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences and keep stakeholders aligned.
  • BS/MS degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.


Nice to have:

  • Experience with native mobile development (Android and/or iOS), including the respective SDKs and app release workflows.
  • Experience with AWS and working with databases.
  • Experience with SDUI and CI/CD.
  • Experience with flutter_bloc.


Perks:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work
  • Flexible PTO
  • Global offices
  • Fun, positive, collaborative environment!

title: Veterinary Radiologist
description:
Veterinary Radiologist - Remote


About SignalPET


SignalPET is a pioneering technology company reshaping veterinary medicine through AI-powered radiograph interpretation. Our mission is to provide fast, accurate, and accessible diagnostic insights to veterinarians around the world.


Role Overview


We are seeking experienced Veterinary Radiologists based in Brazil to join us. In this 100% remote role, you will review AI-assisted radiographic studies, validate findings, and support clinical quality initiatives. This is a unique chance to combine your clinical expertise with innovative technology on a global scale.


Key Responsibilities


  • Review and interpret routine small-animal radiographic studies.
  • Validate the accuracy of AI-generated reports.
  • Provide expert insights and feedback on reported cases.
  • Collaborate with veterinarians and fellow radiologists worldwide.
  • Participate in quality control and system enhancement projects.
  • Stay informed on developments in diagnostic imaging and veterinary AI.


Qualifications


  • Médico Veterinário with specialization in Diagnóstico por Imagem or Radiologia Veterinária .
  • M.V., MSc or M.V., PhD preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in small animal diagnostic imaging.
  • Strong diagnostic and communication skills.
  • Proficient in English (written and spoken).
  • Self-motivated, reliable, and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable working independently and remotely.


What We Offer


  • Fully remote role (Brazil-based).
  • Supportive, international team and culture.
  • Full training provided—no prior AI experience required.
  • A meaningful opportunity to shape the future of veterinary diagnostics.

2. Capacidade Analítica \"Data-Informed\": Saber dizer \"não\" é sua maior ferramenta de priorização. Você usa dados (quant e quali) para convencer, inferir o tamanho de oportunidades e validar hipóteses.

Por que essa vaga?

Se você tem senso de ownership, não se contenta com o básico e quer liderar o digital da maior marca esportiva do mundo dentro de um ambiente de varejo competitivo e dinâmico, seu lugar é aqui.

title: Arquiteto de Software
description:
A VMetrix é uma empresa SaaS que desenvolve uma plataforma financeira integral utilizada por bancos, fundos de pensão, gestoras de fundos, corretoras e asset managers no Chile e na América Latina. Nossa plataforma cobre o ciclo completo de gestão de investimentos: desde a captura de operações e gestão do ciclo de vida transacional, até a precificação, contabilidade, risco de mercado, compliance regulatório e reporting.


Propósito do Cargo

Arquiteto de Software é responsável por definir, evoluir e governar a arquitetura técnica da plataforma VMetrix . Este papel atua como ponte entre os requisitos de negócio financeiro, as restrições regulatórias e a implementação técnica, garantindo que as decisões arquiteturais suportem a escalabilidade, manutenibilidade e compliance da plataforma a longo prazo. Lidera o design dos sistemas mais complexos, estabelece os padrões técnicos para toda a equipe de desenvolvimento e governa a adoção estratégica de ferramentas de IA no ciclo de engenharia.


Responsabilidades Principais:


Desenvolvimento e Manutenção da Plataforma

  • Desenvolver e manter módulos core da plataforma: ciclo de vida transacional (captura, validação, aprovação, liquidação), precificação de instrumentos, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado e reporting regulatório.
  • Implementar lógica de negócio financeiro complexa: processos de precificação mark-to-market, cálculos de P&L, accruals, amortizações, simulações end-of-day e processos batch de fechamento.
  • Escrever código bem estruturado, eficiente, testável e aderente aos padrões arquiteturais definidos pela equipe de Arquitetura.
  • Identificar bugs, gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria na base de código, propondo e implementando soluções com foco em qualidade e manutenibilidade.
  • Antecipar necessidades futuras do sistema, sendo proativo na identificação de riscos técnicos e propondo soluções antes que se tornem impedimentos.


Arquitetura de Dados e PL/SQL

  • Projetar e otimizar procedures PL/SQL em Oracle 21c, incluindo pipelined functions, estratégias com Global Temporary Tables e packages de cálculo financeiro.
  • Construir APIs REST robustas para integração com sistemas externos (ERPs, sistemas contábeis, provedores de dados de mercado), cobrindo múltiplas classes de ativos.
  • Participar no design de motores genéricos com arquitetura metadata-driven, múltiplas estratégias de execução e cache de alto desempenho.


Qualidade, Testes e Revisão de Código

  • Analisar, depurar e testar software de forma sistemática, garantindo conformidade com as especificações técnicas definidas.
  • Realizar revisões de código com foco em qualidade, segurança, performance e aderência aos padrões arquiteturais da plataforma.
  • Definir e aplicar estratégias de testes (unitários, integração, contrato) em colaboração com o time de Arquitetura.
  • Garantir que os módulos desenvolvidos sejam seguros, estáveis e aderentes às exigências regulatórias dos mercados atendidos.


Colaboração Técnica e Mentoria

  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o Arquiteto de Software e Tech Leads para o cumprimento das diretrizes técnicas e das demandas da área.
  • Realizar mentoria técnica de desenvolvedores juniores e plenos: revisões de design, pair programming e transferência de conhecimento do domínio financeiro.
  • Participar ativamente de reuniões técnicas de equipe para discussão e alinhamento de demandas, soluções e prioridades.
  • Monitorar tendências e tecnologias, contribuindo com propostas de melhoria de processos e ferramentas utilizadas no desenvolvimento dos produtos da empresa.


Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA

  • Utilizar ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) de forma produtiva e responsável no ciclo diário de desenvolvimento: geração de código, revisão, debugging e escrita de testes.
  • Elaborar e consumir especificações técnicas otimizadas para uso com LLMs, garantindo que a documentação sirva tanto para a equipe quanto como contexto de alta qualidade para ferramentas de IA generativa.
  • Aplicar engenharia de prompts no contexto de desenvolvimento: formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Formação acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou certificações técnicas relevantes são diferenciais.
  • 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Domínio avançado de Java 8+ e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, transações, testes).
  • Experiência sólida em Oracle Database (PL/SQL, pipelined functions, partitioning, performance tuning, schemas complexos).
  • Conhecimento prático de Kubernetes (OKE) e deployments em containers (Docker, WebLogic em OKE).
  • Experiência com padrões de arquitetura: metadata-driven designs, cache distribuído (Caffeine/Redis), event-driven, repository pattern.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento modernas: Git e Git Flow, pipelines CI/CD, Postman/OpenAPI.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou similares — incluindo uso em geração de código, escrita de testes, refatoração e debugging.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer - (Vue / Node.js)
description:
This is a 100% Remote Independent Contractor Role.


About Equate Media

Equate Media is a growth-focused digital company that builds software and operational systems designed to improve efficiency, support customer engagement, and drive measurable business results. Our teams work closely across engineering, marketing, and operations to solve practical problems, improve workflows, and create systems that make a real impact. We value speed, ownership, adaptability, and people who enjoy building useful things in a fast-moving environment.


About the role

We’re hiring a Senior Full Stack Developer to help strengthen and expand a real-time communications platform used every day by the business. This person will step into an existing production environment, work through active issues, improve platform reliability, and help push new functionality into production quickly.


The work touches both frontend and backend systems tied to inbound and outbound call activity, routing logic, internal buffering, operational tooling, and live user workflows. This is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving real production problems, working across the stack, and making meaningful contributions without a lot of hand-holding.


Where you’ll make an impact

  • Get up to speed quickly in an existing multi-service production platform
  • Investigate and resolve issues across frontend, backend, and third-party integrations
  • Deliver new features at a high pace while keeping stability and maintainability in mind
  • Improve systems that support real-time call flows, routing behavior, and internal buffering
  • Build and refine interfaces used for live operations and communication workflows
  • Develop backend services, APIs, and platform functionality tied directly to business performance
  • Help improve visibility, reliability, and overall behavior in a live production environment
  • Contribute to engineering decisions and help raise execution standards across the team


Tools and environment

  • Frontend: Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, Pinia, Vue Router
  • Backend: Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Express
  • Real-time / Communications: Socket.IO, WebRTC, browser based calling with Twilio/Sinch/similar system
  • Infrastructure / Services: AWS, Redis, RabbitMQ / AMQP, PM2
  • Monitoring / Error Tracking: Sentry


What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience as a full stack software developer
  • Strong backend experience with Node.js
  • Strong frontend experience with Vue, or strong experience with a modern frontend framework and the ability to work confidently in a Vue codebase
  • Experience working in existing production systems, not only creating from scratch
  • Ability to troubleshoot across the stack and solve real-world issues efficiently
  • Experience shipping features quickly in fast-moving environments
  • Strong instincts around performance, reliability, and maintainability
  • Comfortable taking ownership and operating independently
  • Experience with AWS or other cloud-based production environments
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams


Bonus Points For

  • Telephony, VoIP, call routing, or communications platforms
  • Twilio, Sinch, or similar providers
  • Real-time systems, event-driven architecture, queues, or worker-based services
  • Redis, RabbitMQ, or live operational workflows
  • Improving legacy systems while continuing to ship new functionality
  • Exposure to AI-assisted workflows such as transcription, summarization, or automation


Why this role stands out

This is an opportunity to work on a live platform that supports real operational activity and directly impacts the business. You’ll be solving practical problems, improving systems that people rely on every day, and helping shape what gets built next. If you enjoy working in production systems, fixing meaningful problems, and shipping useful features quickly, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Arquiteto de Software
description:
A VMetrix é uma empresa SaaS que desenvolve uma plataforma financeira integral utilizada por bancos, fundos de pensão, gestoras de fundos, corretoras e asset managers no Chile e na América Latina. Nossa plataforma cobre o ciclo completo de gestão de investimentos: desde a captura de operações e gestão do ciclo de vida transacional, até a precificação, contabilidade, risco de mercado, compliance regulatório e reporting.


Propósito do Cargo

Arquiteto de Software é responsável por definir, evoluir e governar a arquitetura técnica da plataforma VMetrix . Este papel atua como ponte entre os requisitos de negócio financeiro, as restrições regulatórias e a implementação técnica, garantindo que as decisões arquiteturais suportem a escalabilidade, manutenibilidade e compliance da plataforma a longo prazo. Lidera o design dos sistemas mais complexos, estabelece os padrões técnicos para toda a equipe de desenvolvimento e governa a adoção estratégica de ferramentas de IA no ciclo de engenharia.


Responsabilidades Principais:


Desenvolvimento e Manutenção da Plataforma

  • Desenvolver e manter módulos core da plataforma: ciclo de vida transacional (captura, validação, aprovação, liquidação), precificação de instrumentos, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado e reporting regulatório.
  • Implementar lógica de negócio financeiro complexa: processos de precificação mark-to-market, cálculos de P&L, accruals, amortizações, simulações end-of-day e processos batch de fechamento.
  • Escrever código bem estruturado, eficiente, testável e aderente aos padrões arquiteturais definidos pela equipe de Arquitetura.
  • Identificar bugs, gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria na base de código, propondo e implementando soluções com foco em qualidade e manutenibilidade.
  • Antecipar necessidades futuras do sistema, sendo proativo na identificação de riscos técnicos e propondo soluções antes que se tornem impedimentos.


Arquitetura de Dados e PL/SQL

  • Projetar e otimizar procedures PL/SQL em Oracle 21c, incluindo pipelined functions, estratégias com Global Temporary Tables e packages de cálculo financeiro.
  • Construir APIs REST robustas para integração com sistemas externos (ERPs, sistemas contábeis, provedores de dados de mercado), cobrindo múltiplas classes de ativos.
  • Participar no design de motores genéricos com arquitetura metadata-driven, múltiplas estratégias de execução e cache de alto desempenho.


Qualidade, Testes e Revisão de Código

  • Analisar, depurar e testar software de forma sistemática, garantindo conformidade com as especificações técnicas definidas.
  • Realizar revisões de código com foco em qualidade, segurança, performance e aderência aos padrões arquiteturais da plataforma.
  • Definir e aplicar estratégias de testes (unitários, integração, contrato) em colaboração com o time de Arquitetura.
  • Garantir que os módulos desenvolvidos sejam seguros, estáveis e aderentes às exigências regulatórias dos mercados atendidos.


Colaboração Técnica e Mentoria

  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o Arquiteto de Software e Tech Leads para o cumprimento das diretrizes técnicas e das demandas da área.
  • Realizar mentoria técnica de desenvolvedores juniores e plenos: revisões de design, pair programming e transferência de conhecimento do domínio financeiro.
  • Participar ativamente de reuniões técnicas de equipe para discussão e alinhamento de demandas, soluções e prioridades.
  • Monitorar tendências e tecnologias, contribuindo com propostas de melhoria de processos e ferramentas utilizadas no desenvolvimento dos produtos da empresa.


Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA

  • Utilizar ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) de forma produtiva e responsável no ciclo diário de desenvolvimento: geração de código, revisão, debugging e escrita de testes.
  • Elaborar e consumir especificações técnicas otimizadas para uso com LLMs, garantindo que a documentação sirva tanto para a equipe quanto como contexto de alta qualidade para ferramentas de IA generativa.
  • Aplicar engenharia de prompts no contexto de desenvolvimento: formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Formação acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou certificações técnicas relevantes são diferenciais.
  • 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Domínio avançado de Java 8+ e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, transações, testes).
  • Experiência sólida em Oracle Database (PL/SQL, pipelined functions, partitioning, performance tuning, schemas complexos).
  • Conhecimento prático de Kubernetes (OKE) e deployments em containers (Docker, WebLogic em OKE).
  • Experiência com padrões de arquitetura: metadata-driven designs, cache distribuído (Caffeine/Redis), event-driven, repository pattern.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento modernas: Git e Git Flow, pipelines CI/CD, Postman/OpenAPI.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou similares — incluindo uso em geração de código, escrita de testes, refatoração e debugging.
  • Capacidade de engenharia de prompts aplicada ao desenvolvimento: saber formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem.
  • Capacidade de ler e produzir especificações técnicas detalhadas em formato Markdown.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento do domínio financeiro: renda fixa, renda variável, derivativos, fundos de investimento, gestão de portfólios, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado.
  • Experiência com regulação financeira brasileira ou latino-americana (CVM, BACEN, ANBIMA, ou órgãos equivalentes).
  • Experiência com integrações Office (Excel Add-ins) para plataformas SaaS financeiras.
  • Familiaridade com padrões da indústria financeira (FpML, ISDA, ou outros).
  • Experiência com observabilidade: Grafana, métricas de aplicação, alerting.
  • Conhecimento de práticas GitOps e versionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC).
  • Familiaridade com testes de contrato (contract testing) e testes de integração em arquiteturas de microsserviços.
  • Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações equivalentes em tecnologias do stack.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas de tecnologia, engenharia ou gestão de inovação.


Processo de Candidatura:

  • Candidatura: Candidate-se diretamente pelo LinkedIn.
  • Teste técnico: Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo.
  • Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência.
  • Decisão: Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não.


Por que trabalhar na VMetrix

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
This would be a fully remote position, CLT model and salary range is 16k-22k BRL/mo.


Must-haves

  • 5+ years of experience as a Full-Stack Software Engineer (approximately 70% front end, 30% back end)
  • Strong JavaScript expertise, including ReactJS, Handlebars.js, and ASP.NET (Visual Studio) for modifying and extending UI components
  • Backend development experience using C#, .NET Core, and Entity Framework, including creating and modifying REST endpoints and extending data models
  • SQL experience across MS SQL, SQLite, and PostgreSQL, including writing queries and stored procedures to extract data


Plusses

  • Experience with C++ development
  • Familiarity with Accessibility standards and related processes


Day-to-Day

You’ll work in a swarm model, focusing on one priority product at a time to deliver measurable ADA/WCAG improvements before moving on to the next. The role is front-end heavy (~70%), involving refactoring and enhancing React, Handlebars, and ASP.NET components to meet accessibility standards. The remaining ~30% is back-end focused, extending models and creating or modifying REST endpoints in .NET Core/C# to support updated UI flows. You’ll partner closely with Product, UX, and Engineering teams, implement from pre-written accessibility requirements, validate outcomes against the VPAT, and document improvements. Collaboration happens through Teams, daily standups, code reviews, proactive risk and blocker management, and tracking progress toward 2026 goals.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer - (Vue / Node.js)
description:
This is a 100% Remote Independent Contractor Role.


About Equate Media

Equate Media is a growth-focused digital company that builds software and operational systems designed to improve efficiency, support customer engagement, and drive measurable business results. Our teams work closely across engineering, marketing, and operations to solve practical problems, improve workflows, and create systems that make a real impact. We value speed, ownership, adaptability, and people who enjoy building useful things in a fast-moving environment.


About the role

We’re hiring a Senior Full Stack Developer to help strengthen and expand a real-time communications platform used every day by the business. This person will step into an existing production environment, work through active issues, improve platform reliability, and help push new functionality into production quickly.


The work touches both frontend and backend systems tied to inbound and outbound call activity, routing logic, internal buffering, operational tooling, and live user workflows. This is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving real production problems, working across the stack, and making meaningful contributions without a lot of hand-holding.


Where you’ll make an impact

  • Get up to speed quickly in an existing multi-service production platform
  • Investigate and resolve issues across frontend, backend, and third-party integrations
  • Deliver new features at a high pace while keeping stability and maintainability in mind
  • Improve systems that support real-time call flows, routing behavior, and internal buffering
  • Build and refine interfaces used for live operations and communication workflows
  • Develop backend services, APIs, and platform functionality tied directly to business performance
  • Help improve visibility, reliability, and overall behavior in a live production environment
  • Contribute to engineering decisions and help raise execution standards across the team


Tools and environment

  • Frontend: Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, Pinia, Vue Router
  • Backend: Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Express
  • Real-time / Communications: Socket.IO, WebRTC, browser based calling with Twilio/Sinch/similar system
  • Infrastructure / Services: AWS, Redis, RabbitMQ / AMQP, PM2
  • Monitoring / Error Tracking: Sentry


What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience as a full stack software developer
  • Strong backend experience with Node.js
  • Strong frontend experience with Vue, or strong experience with a modern frontend framework and the ability to work confidently in a Vue codebase
  • Experience working in existing production systems, not only creating from scratch
  • Ability to troubleshoot across the stack and solve real-world issues efficiently
  • Experience shipping features quickly in fast-moving environments
  • Strong instincts around performance, reliability, and maintainability
  • Comfortable taking ownership and operating independently
  • Experience with AWS or other cloud-based production environments
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams


Bonus Points For

  • Telephony, VoIP, call routing, or communications platforms
  • Twilio, Sinch, or similar providers
  • Real-time systems, event-driven architecture, queues, or worker-based services
  • Redis, RabbitMQ, or live operational workflows
  • Improving legacy systems while continuing to ship new functionality
  • Exposure to AI-assisted workflows such as transcription, summarization, or automation


Why this role stands out

This is an opportunity to work on a live platform that supports real operational activity and directly impacts the business. You’ll be solving practical problems, improving systems that people rely on every day, and helping shape what gets built next. If you enjoy working in production systems, fixing meaningful problems, and shipping useful features quickly, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Flutter/Node.js)
description:
About the Company:

Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.


Role Description:

Headspace is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack with Flutter focus) to support our Employer Solutions team. This team builds the foundational capabilities that power our commercial partnerships by enabling hundreds of employers to offer Headspace as a benefit to their workforce. title: Creative Software Specialist - 64877
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

We are looking for Creative Software Specialists experienced in open-source creative tools to produce structured digital content such as animations, illustrations, video, audio, layouts, or interactive scenes. The role requires clear documentation of the creative workflow and the ability to submit organized project files and outputs.


Requirements:

  • Strong English communication skills (written and spoken).
  • Computer with 16 GB RAM or more (mandatory).
  • Ability to operate Linux/Ubuntu in a virtual environment .
  • Proficiency in at least one of the following tools: Blender, OpenToonz, Synfig Studio, Pencil2D, Kdenlive, OpenShot, GIMP, Inkscape, Krita, Audacity, Scribus, or Godot .


Key Responsibilities:

  • Produce structured creative outputs (animation, video, graphics, audio, layouts, or game scenes).
  • Maintain native project files with organized layers, timelines, or assets .
  • Demonstrate workflow progression (draft → intermediate stages → final output).
  • Document tools, effects, logic, and project structure for reproducibility and review.
  • Export deliverables in appropriate formats (e.g., video, audio, images, vector files, or playable builds ).


Benefits:

  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : at least 4 hours per day and a total of 40 hours per week with 2-4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract: 16 weeks
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-4 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent automated analytical challenges.
  • Once you clear them, you are ready to go!

This position is perfect for someone interested in building powerful cybersecurity products and features for our enterprise customers. Our solutions help fuel mission critical efforts for customers including gathering threat intelligence, doing threat hunting, and performing online fraud investigation, and more.


At DomainTools, you will work as part of a collaborative team of smart and engaged engineers. Expect to spend most of your time developing modern JavaScript single page applications powered by PHR middleware APIs. You will work in an environment where productivity is fostered. You will spend very little time in meetings, and you won’t be distracted by processes that get in the way of high-quality results.


Have you worked with modern PHP OOP frameworks such as Laravel of Symfony? Are you well versed in using CSS and UX to make beautiful and streamlined designs? Have you built successful end to end testing solutions? If you answered yes to any of these questions we would like to chat with you. However, it is required that you are very comfortable with JavaScript.


Job Responsibilities

  • Produce well designed, testable, efficient code using software development best practices.
  • Integrate with and utilize data from backend services and databases.
  • Build web applications using PHP on the backend and JavaScript (ES7+), HTML5, and CSS3 on the frontend.
  • Contribute to new product ideation and implementation as well as to feature development of existing products.
  • Collaborate with teammates by actively participating in code reviews, contributing to technical documentation, and offering constructive design feedback.
  • Become a subject matter expert on DomainTools’ customer facing products and services.


Key Applicant Qualifications

  • Work experience: 3+ years of modern web application development.
  • Experience with modern PHP frameworks (Laravel, Symfony).
  • Solid knowledge of the following:
  • Object oriented PHP 7+ programming
  • JavaScript (ES7+)
  • TypeScript

  • Deep understanding of React 18+ and Redux.

Pluses
